Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 FAQs

What is the last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

There is no common last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026. Each state or district publishes its own closing date. Check the live recruitment table for the applicable notification.

Where can I apply for Anganwadi jobs online in 2026?

Apply through the official state or district recruitment portal mentioned in the specific advertisement. Some Anganwadi recruitments require offline applications instead.

Is Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026 available?

Supervisor vacancies are announced separately by the relevant recruitment authorities. Candidates should confirm an active Supervisor notification before applying.

What is the last date for Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026?

The last date depends on the state and the Supervisor advertisement. Worker and Helper application deadlines do not automatically apply to Supervisor posts.

Can 10th or 12th pass candidates apply for Anganwadi jobs?

Yes, some Anganwadi Worker and Helper notifications accept Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications. The required qualification depends on the post and recruiting authority.

Is there an examination for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

The selection method depends on the official notification. Candidates should check whether the recruitment involves academic merit, a written examination, interview or other prescribed stages.

How can I find Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 in Haryana or Telangana?

Check the state-wise recruitment section and open the relevant district notification. Verify the post, vacancy, deadline and application mode before applying.

Where can I find Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 in Maharashtra?

Check the relevant Maharashtra Women and Child Development or district recruitment notification for Anganwadi Sevika, Helper and Supervisor vacancies, as applicable.

Is wcd.gov.in the Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 official website?

Can I apply for an Anganwadi vacancy in another district?

That depends on the recruitment's residence and eligibility rules. Some Worker and Helper notices require candidates to belong to a particular village, ward or project area.

Forest Guard Recruitment 2026 - Latest Vacancies & Eligibility

Forest Guard recruitment is suitable for candidates interested in forest protection, patrolling and field-level government work. Forest Guard vacancies are generally announced by state forest departments or authorized recruitment boards.

What does a Forest Guard do?

A Forest Guard helps protect forest areas, monitor activities, assist with wildlife conservation and report suspected forest offences. Duties can include patrolling assigned forest areas and supporting senior forest officials.

What is the qualification for Forest Guard Recruitment 2026?

Some Forest Guard recruitments require Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications from a recognized board. However, the exact educational requirements depend on the state and recruitment notification.

Candidates should check:

  • Education: Required qualification and recognized board.
  • Age Limit: Minimum and maximum age, including the age-calculation date.
  • Physical Standards: Height, chest measurements or other applicable requirements.
  • Selection Process: Written examination, physical tests or other notified stages.
  • Vacancies: Total and category-wise posts.
  • Application Dates: Registration opening and closing dates.

How can I apply for Forest Guard Vacancy 2026?

Find the Forest Guard recruitment in the vacancy table above, open the detailed notification, confirm eligibility and follow the official application instructions.

Candidates should apply only through the website or submission method prescribed by the recruiting authority.

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 - RFO Jobs

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 provides opportunities for candidates interested in forest administration, conservation and supervisory roles.

A Forest Range Officer, also referred to as a Range Forest Officer or RFO in some recruitment systems, may oversee forest protection activities, supervise field staff and manage responsibilities within an assigned forest range.

What is the qualification for Forest Range Officer recruitment?

Forest Range Officer recruitment generally involves graduate-level eligibility. Some notifications require degrees in specified subjects such as science, agriculture, forestry or other approved disciplines.

The accepted qualifications vary by recruiting organization. A graduation degree alone does not automatically make a candidate eligible for every RFO vacancy.

How are Forest Range Officers selected?

Depending on the recruitment rules, selection may include:

  • Preliminary or main written examinations
  • Physical standards or fitness assessments
  • Interviews, where prescribed
  • Document verification
  • Medical examination

Candidates searching for RFO Vacancy 2026, Forest Ranger Recruitment or Forest Range Service Officer notifications should check the relevant vacancy details for exact eligibility and selection stages.

Forest-related government jobs include field protection, administration, conservation, research and technical positions.

Which Forest Department post should you apply for? Choose a post based on your educational qualification, age, physical eligibility, preferred work and the conditions specified in the official notification.

The availability of these posts varies by recruitment cycle and state.

Identify your state in the recruiting organization's name or recruitment details. Open the applicable notification to check the job location, state eligibility requirements, reservation rules and official application website.

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for Forest Department jobs depends on the post, department and recruitment rules.

Educational Qualification

Post Category Common Qualification Pattern
Forest Guard / Forest Watcher Some recruitments accept Class 10 or Class 12
Forester School-level or higher qualifications, as notified
Forest Beat Officer Qualification specified by the recruiting board
Forest Range Officer Usually a degree, sometimes in specified subjects
Assistant Conservator of Forests Degree requirements under the relevant service rules
Technical and Research Posts Relevant diploma, degree or specialized qualification
Clerical and Support Posts Post-specific educational and skill requirements

These are general patterns, not fixed nationwide eligibility criteria.

What is the age limit for Forest Department jobs?

There is no common age limit for all Forest Department recruitment in India.

Each notification specifies the minimum age, maximum age, applicable cut-off date and age-relaxation rules.

Candidates belonging to reserved categories, including eligible ex-servicemen, should check the provisions applicable to their recruitment.

Is a physical test compulsory for Forest Department jobs?

Physical standards and fitness assessments are common in certain field-level posts, particularly Forest Guard and some officer-level recruitment.

However, not every Forest Department post has a physical test. Technical, administrative and other positions may follow different selection procedures.

Where physical testing is required, the official notification specifies the standards, test format and qualifying conditions.

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates & Last Date

What is the last date to apply for Forest Department Recruitment 2026?

There is no single closing date for every Forest Department vacancy. Application deadlines are set separately by the recruiting authorities.

Check the latest recruitment table for the last date of each available notification.

  • Notification release date
  • Application start date
  • Application closing date
  • Last date for fee payment
  • Form correction dates, if available
  • Examination date
  • Admit card release date
  • Result announcement

Before applying: Confirm the closing date and time zone, if specified, in the official notification. Do not assume that a registration deadline has been extended unless the recruiting authority confirms it.

How to Apply for Forest Department Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online or offline according to the instructions issued for the specific vacancy.

Application process

  1. Choose a vacancy: Find a suitable Forest Department job in the recruitment table.
  2. Check eligibility: Verify the qualification, age limit, physical requirements and other conditions.
  3. Read the notification: Review the official recruitment PDF and important instructions.
  4. Open the application link: Visit the authorized recruitment portal or follow the offline application procedure.
  5. Complete the form: Enter the required personal, educational and contact details.
  6. Submit documents: Upload or attach the prescribed certificates and photographs.
  7. Pay the fee: Complete payment if the notification requires an application fee.
  8. Submit the application: Review the details and complete submission before the deadline.
  9. Save confirmation: Keep the acknowledgment or completed application for future reference.

Which documents are required?

The required documents vary by recruitment. Applicants may need educational certificates, identity proof, photograph, signature, category certificates, domicile documents or other eligibility records.

Always follow the document list and format requirements mentioned in the official notification.

Forest Department Selection Process 2026

How are candidates selected for Forest Department jobs?

Recruiting organizations use different selection methods based on the post. Some Forest Guard and officer-level vacancies include written examinations and physical tests, while technical or administrative roles may involve skill tests or interviews.

Selection Stage What Candidates Should Know
Written Examination Tests knowledge or skills specified in the official syllabus
Physical Standard Test (PST) Checks prescribed physical measurements
Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Assesses fitness through notified activities
Skill Test / Interview Conducted when required for the position
Document Verification Confirms qualifications and eligibility documents
Medical Examination Checks medical fitness where prescribed

Not every candidate will undergo every stage. The official recruitment notice determines the actual selection procedure and the basis for preparing the merit list.

What is the Forest Guard exam syllabus?

Where a written examination is required, the syllabus may cover General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Science, Mathematics, Reasoning, environmental topics or state-specific subjects.

Candidates should follow the syllabus and examination pattern published for their particular Forest Guard or Forest Range Officer recruitment.

Forest Department Jobs Salary 2026

How much salary do Forest Department employees receive?

Forest Department salaries depend on the post, state, pay scale, appointment category and service rules.

For example, a Forest Guard's pay may differ from that of a Forester, Range Forest Officer or Assistant Conservator of Forests.

Post Pay Level / Pay Scale Approximate Gross Salary (Monthly)
Forest Guard / Field Guard Pay Level 3 ₹28,000 – ₹35,000
Forester Pay Level 4–5 ₹35,000 – ₹45,000
Range Forest Officer Pay Level 7–8 ₹50,000 – ₹65,000
Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) Pay Level 10 ₹70,000 – ₹95,000
Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer Pay Level 10 and above ₹80,000+ (with allowances)

Regular positions may carry a prescribed pay level and allowances, while contractual or project-based posts may offer fixed monthly remuneration.

Before applying, check:

  • Basic pay or consolidated remuneration
  • Pay level and salary scale
  • Applicable allowances
  • Probation or contract terms
  • Other service conditions

The official recruitment notification is the correct source for the salary of a specific vacancy.

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Official Notification & Application Website

There is no single national application website for all state Forest Department jobs.

Recruitment may be handled by a state Forest Department, Public Service Commission, staff selection board or another authorized organization.

To locate the correct official website:

  1. Find your preferred vacancy in the recruitment table.
  2. Open its detailed job notification.
  3. Check the name of the recruiting authority.
  4. Open the official notification PDF.
  5. Follow the application link or instructions provided by the recruiting authority.

OnlyJobs publishes recruitment information to help candidates find opportunities. The official recruiting organization remains the authoritative source for eligibility, deadlines, results and application procedures.

वन विभाग भर्ती 2026 के लिए आवेदन कैसे करें?

उम्मीदवार ऊपर दी गई भर्ती सूची में संबंधित पद चुनकर योग्यता, आयु सीमा, आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि और आधिकारिक नोटिफिकेशन देख सकते हैं। आवेदन करने से पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें।

Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Frequently Asked Questions

1. Is Forest Department Recruitment 2026 open?

Forest-related vacancies are announced throughout the year by different recruiting organizations. Check the latest vacancy table above for the status of individual recruitments. An advertised post should be considered open only within its confirmed application period.

2. What is the last date for Forest Department Recruitment 2026?

The last date differs for each recruitment. Check the applicable notification's closing date in the table and verify it against the official announcement.

3. How can I apply for Forest Guard Recruitment 2026?

Find an applicable Forest Guard vacancy, review the educational and physical requirements, and follow the official application instructions before the closing date.

4. Can 10th-pass candidates apply for Forest Department jobs?

Some Forest Guard, Forest Watcher and support recruitments may accept Class 10 qualifications. Eligibility depends on the post and recruiting authority.

5. Can 12th-pass candidates apply for Forest Guard vacancies?

Yes, some Forest Guard recruitments accept Class 12 qualifications. Check the specific notification to confirm any subject or additional eligibility requirements.

6. Can graduates apply for Forest Range Officer recruitment?

Graduates may qualify for certain Forest Range Officer vacancies, but some recruitments require degrees in specified disciplines. Candidates must verify the accepted qualifications.

7. Is a physical test required for Forest Guard recruitment?

Many Forest Guard recruitments include physical standards or fitness tests. The exact requirements depend on the recruiting authority.

8. What is the age limit for Forest Guard recruitment?

The age limit varies by state and notification. Check the official minimum and maximum ages, cut-off date and applicable relaxations.

9. Is there an exam for Forest Department jobs?

Many Forest Guard, Forester and officer-level recruitments include written examinations. Other roles may use different selection methods. Follow the official selection process for the chosen vacancy.

10. What is the difference between a Forest Guard and a Forest Range Officer?

A Forest Guard generally performs field-level protection and monitoring duties. A Forest Range Officer usually carries supervisory and administrative responsibilities for a forest range. Exact duties differ under the relevant service rules.

11. Can ex-servicemen apply for Forest Department recruitment?

Eligible ex-servicemen can apply for vacancies where they meet the recruitment requirements. Reservation benefits and relaxations depend on the applicable rules.

12. Are Forest Department jobs available in every state?

Different states announce vacancies at different times. Not every state or post necessarily has an active recruitment notification at any given moment.

13. Is there a single apply online link for all Forest Department vacancies?

No. Each recruiting organization may use a different application portal or offline application process.

14. Where can I download the official Forest Department notification PDF?

Open the relevant recruitment from the latest vacancy table and follow its official notification link.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Applicants should check the additional conditions for special education qualifications in the notification.

AEES has advertised Computer Science teaching vacancies at both PGT and TGT levels. For PGT Computer Science, the prescribed qualifications include relevant postgraduate computing qualifications and an accepted teaching qualification. For TGT Computer Science, the notification accepts specified undergraduate Computer Science / IT qualifications or equivalent routes with B.Ed.

AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 age limit depends on the post. The maximum age ranges from 30 years for Primary Teacher and Balvatika Teacher posts to 50 years for Principal.

Post Name Age Limit
Principal 35 to 50 Years
Vice-Principal 35 to 45 Years
Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) Maximum 40 Years
Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) Maximum 35 Years
Librarian Maximum 35 Years
Primary Teacher (PRT) Maximum 30 Years
Primary Teacher (Music) Maximum 30 Years
Balvatika Teacher Maximum 30 Years

AEES Age Relaxation 2026

Category Upper Age Relaxation
SC / ST 5 Years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 Years
Eligible Women Applicants 10 Years for Specified Teaching and Librarian Posts
PwBD (General) 10 Years
PwBD (OBC-NCL) 13 Years
PwBD (SC / ST) 15 Years

Other age concessions apply to eligible AEES employees, government servants and ex-servicemen according to the official notification. Where multiple concessions apply, only the highest permissible relaxation is granted under the notification's rules.

AEES Teacher Salary 2026 - PRT, TGT, PGT Pay Scale

The AEES Teacher Salary 2026 depends on the post and pay level under the applicable pay matrix. The starting basic pay ranges from Rs. 35,400 for PRT and Balvatika Teacher posts to Rs. 78,800 for Principal.

Post Name Pay Level Pay Scale
Principal Level 12 Rs. 78,800 - 2,09,200
Vice-Principal Level 10 Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500
PGT Level 8 Rs. 47,600 - 1,51,100
TGT Level 7 Rs. 44,900 - 1,42,400
Librarian Level 7 Rs. 44,900 - 1,42,400
PRT Level 6 Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400
PRT Music Level 6 Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400
Balvatika Teacher Level 6 Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400

AEES PRT Salary Per Month 2026

The starting basic pay for AEES Primary Teachers is Rs. 35,400 per month under Pay Level 6. The pay matrix extends up to Rs. 1,12,400. Actual gross salary and take-home salary will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

AEES TGT Salary Per Month 2026

AEES TGT teachers receive a pay scale of Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 under Pay Level 7. The starting basic pay is Rs. 44,900 per month.

AEES PGT Salary Per Month 2026

The AEES PGT pay scale is Rs. 47,600 to Rs. 1,51,100 under Pay Level 8. The starting basic pay is Rs. 47,600 per month, excluding applicable allowances.

AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The AEES Recruitment 2026 application fee consists of an application fee and a processing fee. The fee amount depends on the candidate's category.

Category Application Fee Processing Fee Total Before GST
General / OBC / EWS Rs. 750 Rs. 250 Rs. 1,000
Women / SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen Exempted Rs. 250 Rs. 250

Note: Applicable GST is charged additionally by the bank. Payment must be made online through the prescribed payment gateway. Candidates applying for different permitted posts must pay the required fee separately for each post.

AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by an interview or skill test, as applicable to the post.

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT)
  2. Interview or Skill Test, depending on the post
  3. Document Verification
  4. Other prescribed appointment formalities

For Principal and Vice-Principal posts, selection includes CBT and interview. For other notified posts, AEES applies the relevant CBT merit, skill test or interview requirements specified in the official notification.

AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Syllabus and Exam Pattern

The AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 syllabus covers general knowledge, reasoning, language ability, computer knowledge, teaching methodology and subject-related knowledge. The examination pattern differs between school leadership posts and other teaching posts.

AEES Teacher Syllabus 2026

AEES PGT, TGT, PRT and Librarian Exam Pattern 2026

Subject Questions Marks
General English 5 5
General Hindi 5 5
General Reasoning 5 5
General Knowledge 5 5
Basic Computer Literacy 5 5
Numerical Ability 5 5
Teaching Methodology 15 15
Concerned Subject 75 75
Total 120 120

Exam Duration: 2 Hours

Negative Marking: No negative marking

AEES Principal and Vice-Principal Exam Pattern 2026

The CBT for Principal and Vice-Principal posts comprises 150 questions for 150 marks with a duration of 2 hours and 30 minutes. There is no negative marking.

The syllabus includes General English, General Hindi, Reasoning, General Knowledge, Basic Computer Literacy, Numerical Ability, Teaching and Learning, School Organization, Leadership, Management, Administration and Finance.

Candidates can access the detailed post-wise AEES syllabus through the official AEES application portal.

AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

Eligible candidates can submit the AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 application form online through the official recruitment portal. Applications are accepted from 2 November 2026 at 10:00 AM until 29 November 2026 at 11:50 PM.

Apply Online: AEES Recruitment 2026 Online Application Portal

Important: Candidates may apply for more than one permitted post by paying the respective fees separately. However, applicants can select only one subject within the PGT category and only one subject within the TGT category.

How to Apply Online for AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official AEES application portal at aees.onlineregistrationforms.com.
  2. Read AEES Recruitment Notification 01/2026 carefully.
  3. Register using your personal email ID and mobile number.
  4. Log in and select the eligible post and subject.
  5. Enter the required personal, educational and other application details.
  6. Upload the prescribed photograph, certificates and documents as instructed.
  7. Check the category-wise application fee and processing fee.
  8. Pay the required fee through the online payment gateway.
  9. Review all entered details and complete application submission.
  10. Download and print the confirmation page for future reference.

Note: AEES states that an application without a generated confirmation page will be treated as incomplete. Candidates do not need to send a printed application to AEES by post.

Atomic Energy Education Society has published Recruitment Notification 01/2026 for 254 teaching and related vacancies. The detailed notification contains post-wise vacancies, qualifications, pay scales, age relaxation, examination scheme, selection rules, fees and application guidelines.

Candidates should download the official notification and check the applicable annexures before applying online.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip 2026 has been released by the Staff Selection Commission (SSC) for candidates appearing in the Junior Engineer (Telecommunication) Paper 1 examination. The city intimation details became available on 20 November 2026 for candidates scheduled to appear on 30 November, while the exam city facility for the 1 December examination was scheduled to become available on 21 November 2026. Candidates can check their allotted examination city, date and shift through the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in using their registered login credentials.

The SSC JE Telecommunication Paper 1 Examination 2026 will be conducted on 30 November and 1 December 2026 in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode. The exam city slip helps candidates plan their travel before the admission certificate is issued. According to the official SSC notice, admit cards will be made available approximately two to three days before the respective examination date. Candidates should check their city details now and download their admission certificates separately when available.

SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip 2026 Overview

The Staff Selection Commission has released the examination city details for the upcoming Junior Engineer (Telecommunication) Paper 1 examination. Candidates can check the important information below.

SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip 2026 Download Link

The SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip 2026 link is available through the official Staff Selection Commission candidate login. Applicants can sign in to view their allotted examination city and scheduled date for the Junior Engineer (Telecommunication) Paper 1 examination.

Candidates should use the official link below to check their exam city details. The complete examination centre address will be provided later through the admission certificate.

SSC JE Telecom City Slip 2026 Release Date

The SSC JE Telecommunication Exam City Slip 2026 has been made available according to the candidate's examination date. The Commission's earlier official notice stated that city information would become available approximately 8 to 10 days before the examination.

SSC JE Telecom Exam Date City Slip Release Date Status
30 November 2026 20 November 2026 Released

How to Check SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip 2026?

Candidates can follow these steps to check the SSC JE Telecommunication Exam City 2026 through the official website:

  1. Visit the Staff Selection Commission website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Click the Login or Register option on the homepage.
  3. Enter your registered SSC username or registration number and password.
  4. Complete any verification requested by the login page.
  5. Open the candidate dashboard after logging in.
  6. Find the Junior Engineer Examination 2026 Paper 1 city intimation or admission certificate section.
  7. Select the available examination city information for JE (Telecommunication).
  8. Check the allotted examination city, date and shift details.
  9. Save the displayed information or download the city slip if the option is provided.

Direct Link: SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip 2026 Login

SSC JE Telecom Exam Date 2026

The Staff Selection Commission will conduct the SSC Junior Engineer (Telecommunication) Paper 1 Examination on 30 November and 1 December 2026. The examination dates were confirmed in the official SSC notice dated 23 October 2026.

Post Paper Exam Date
Junior Engineer (Telecommunication) Paper 1 30 November 2026
Junior Engineer (Telecommunication) Paper 1 1 December 2026

The examinations for other Junior Engineer disciplines and certain Scientific Assistant (IMD) papers were scheduled separately from 2 to 6 November 2026. Candidates applying for multiple eligible posts should check the relevant examination details individually in their SSC accounts.

The exact examination shift and reporting time for each candidate should be checked on the city intimation information and final admission certificate.

SSC JE Telecom Admit Card 2026 Release Date

The SSC JE Telecom Admit Card 2026 is expected to be released approximately two to three days before the respective examination date, according to the official Staff Selection Commission notice.

Candidates appearing on 30 November 2026 should check for their admission certificates around 27-28 November, while candidates scheduled for 1 December 2026 should check around 28-29 November. These are indicative dates based on the official release window, not separately confirmed publication dates.

The SSC JE Telecom admission certificate will provide the complete examination centre address, reporting time and instructions required to appear for Paper 1.

SSC JE Telecom Exam City and Admit Card Important Dates 2026

Event Date
Official SSC City Intimation Notice 23 October 2026

SSC JE Telecom Paper 1 Exam 30 November and 1 December 2026

Details Mentioned on SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip 2026

The SSC JE Telecom Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 provides advance information regarding the candidate's examination schedule. Depending on the details displayed in the official SSC login, the information may include:

  • Candidate's Name
  • SSC Registration Number
  • Examination Name
  • Post Applied For
  • Allotted Examination City and State
  • Examination Date
  • Examination Shift
  • Other Examination Instructions

The city intimation slip does not necessarily contain the complete examination centre address. Candidates should check their final admission certificates for the exact venue and entry requirements.

Difference Between SSC JE Telecom City Slip and Admit Card

The SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip and admission certificate serve different purposes. Candidates should understand the distinction before appearing for the examination.

City Intimation Slip Admit Card / Admission Certificate
Provides advance examination city information Provides complete examination centre details
Released 8-10 days before the examination Generally issued 2-3 days before the examination
Helps candidates plan travel Required for examination entry
May display exam date and shift Displays reporting time and examination instructions

Candidates must download their official admission certificates before the examination. The city intimation slip alone should not be treated as a valid examination entry document.

Documents Required for SSC JE Telecom Paper 1 Exam 2026

Candidates appearing for the SSC JE Telecommunication Paper 1 examination must carry the documents prescribed in their admission certificates and the official examination instructions.

The required documents may include:

  • Printed SSC JE Telecom Admission Certificate 2026.
  • Original valid photo identity proof accepted by SSC.
  • Recent passport-size photographs, if required under the admission certificate instructions.
  • Additional proof of date of birth, if the identity document does not contain the required information.
  • Relevant PwBD or scribe-related documents, wherever applicable.
  • Any additional document specified by the Commission.

Candidates should follow the exact document requirements provided on their admission certificates. They should not rely on the city intimation slip as proof of admission to the examination.

SSC JE Telecom Paper 1 Exam 2026 Important Instructions

Candidates preparing for the SSC JE Telecommunication examination should follow these important instructions:

  • Check the examination city using the official SSC candidate login.
  • Confirm the individually allotted examination date and shift.
  • Download the admission certificate when released.
  • Verify the examination centre address and reporting time.
  • Carry the printed admission certificate and required original identity documents.
  • Reach the examination centre according to the reporting instructions.
  • Do not carry prohibited electronic devices or materials.
  • Follow the instructions issued by the examination authorities.

Candidates who have applied for multiple SSC posts should carefully verify the examination name and discipline displayed in their login before downloading the relevant document.

What to Do If SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip 2026 Is Not Showing?

If the SSC JE Telecom City Intimation Slip 2026 is not visible after logging in, candidates should first confirm that they are using the correct SSC registration details and the relevant examination section.

The city intimation facility is released according to the examination schedule, so candidates should check whether the facility has been activated for their assigned date. Applicants may also sign out and log in again to refresh the dashboard.

If the information is still unavailable, candidates should check the latest SSC notices or contact the relevant regional office through official support channels.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), in Advertisement No. 13/2026, invites online applications for 13 vacancies in four posts: Dental Surgeon (5, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare), Ayurveda Physician (2) and Homeopathic Physician (1) (both New Delhi Municipal Council), and Scientist 'B' (5, Botanical Survey of India, Ministry of Environment Forests and Climate Change). All four posts are at Level 10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC. Candidates are shortlisted for interview, with a Recruitment Test if held. Applications are taken on upsconline.nic.in from 14 November 2026 until 1800 hrs on 04 December 2026, and eligibility is fixed on that closing date.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview

This is a recruitment by selection to four Group A Gazetted, Non-Ministerial posts under the Central Government and the New Delhi Municipal Council. The Scientist 'B' post was advertised earlier and is re-advertised with changed PwBD suitability.

Particulars Details
Recruiting Organisation Union Public Service Commission
Recruitment Name Recruitment by selection, Advertisement No. 13/2026
Advertisement No. 13/2026
Notification Date 14-11-2026
Post Names Dental Surgeon; Ayurveda Physician; Homeopathic Physician; Scientist 'B'
Total Vacancies 13
Departments Department of Health & Family Welfare; New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC); Botanical Survey of India
Qualification Varies by post: BDS, Ayurveda degree, Homoeopathy degree or Master's Degree in Botany/Horticulture/Chemistry (Organic)
Age Limit Varies by post
Pay Level or Pay Level 10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC (plus NPA for Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician)
Application Fee Rs. 25/- (no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women)
Application Mode Online at https://upsconline.nic.in
Application Dates 14-11-2026 to 04-12-2026 (1800 hrs)
Selection Process Shortlisting, Recruitment Test (if held), interview
Job Location Anywhere in India (Dental Surgeon); New Delhi (NDMC posts); Kolkata (Scientist 'B')
Official Website https://upsconline.nic.in

The official notification does not specify the Recruitment Test pattern or the interview date.

About UPSC Recruitment 2026

The Union Public Service Commission invites these applications through its online recruitment application portal. The Dental Surgeon post serves in Safdarjung Hospital, Dr. RML Hospital and RHTC Najafgarh. The Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician posts are in the AYUSH Cadre of the New Delhi Municipal Council. The Scientist 'B' post is at the Botanical Survey of India, CGO Complex, Salt Lake City, Kolkata.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement published / online applications start 14-11-2026
Last date for online applications 04-12-2026, 1800 hrs
Date for age and similar eligibility conditions, Scientist 'B' only (original closing date) 03-07-2026
Interview date To be intimated separately

Applications start on 14 November 2026. The date for determining the eligibility of all candidates in every respect is the closing date for online applications. For Scientist 'B', the notice says the original closing date, 03.07.2026, prevails for age and similar eligibility conditions.

UPSC Vacancy 2026

The notice carries 13 vacancies in total: 5 + 2 + 1 + 5.

Post Vacancy No. Organisation Pay Level Vacancies
Dental Surgeon 26111301114 Department of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare Level 10 5
Ayurveda Physician 26111302114 New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) Level 10 plus NPA 2
Homeopathic Physician 26111303114 New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) Level 10 plus NPA 1
Scientist 'B' 26111304214 Botanical Survey of India, Ministry of Environment Forests and Climate Change Level 10 5
Total 13

UPSC Category-wise Vacancy 2026

Post UR EWS OBC SC Total
Dental Surgeon 3 1 - 1 5
Ayurveda Physician 1 1 - - 2
Homeopathic Physician - 1 - - 1
Scientist 'B' 2 1 1 1 5

Of the five Dental Surgeon vacancies, one is reserved for persons with benchmark disability (PwBD) in the Deaf and Hard of Hearing category. Ayurveda Physician, Homeopathic Physician and Scientist 'B' are not reserved for PwBD but are identified as suitable for certain disability types. The disability-type suitability tables for each post are in the official notification.

The five Scientist 'B' vacancies may be filled by candidates with these disciplines: MSc Botany - 3; MSc Horticulture - 1; MSc Chemistry (Organic) - 1.

UPSC Eligibility Criteria 2026

Post Qualification Required
Dental Surgeon A recognised Bachelor of Dental Surgery degree included in part-1 of the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948), or one of the alternatives listed below; registration with any State Dental Council or Tribunal in India; completion of CRI.
Ayurveda Physician Degree in Ayurveda of a recognized University/Statutory State Board/Council/Faculty of Indian Systems of Medicine recognized under the Indian Medicine Central Council Act 1970 (48 of 1970); enrolment on the Centre or a State Register for Indian Medicine.
Homeopathic Physician Degree in Homoeopathy of a Recognised University/Statutory State Board/Council or equivalent recognised under the Homoeopathic Central Council Act, 1973 (59 of 1973); enrolment on the Central Register of Homoeopathy or State Register of Homoeopathy.
Scientist 'B' Master's Degree in Botany or Horticulture or Chemistry (Organic) from a recognised University or Institute. Desirable: Doctorate in the same subjects.

Dental Surgeon: alternative qualifications

  • A recognised Dental qualification obtained upto 01.11.1972 under Part-II of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948).
  • OR a recognised Dental qualification granted by an authority or institution outside India, only when granted to a citizen of India upto 13.08.2009 under Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948.
  • OR a citizen of India with a foreign qualification who has appeared and passed the Screening Test Examination as per Screening Test Regulation 2009 w.e.f. 13.08.2009.
  • Candidates who have not completed CRI (compulsory rotating internship) may appear for selection, but if selected must complete it satisfactorily before appointment.

Other conditions

  • Citizenship: a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from the countries named in the notice. The last three groups need a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.
  • Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of UPSC, for reasons to be recorded in writing, for candidates otherwise well qualified.
  • Where enough eligible PwBD candidates are not available for posts reserved or identified suitable for them, the experience qualification may be relaxed up to 50 per cent. The notice prints no experience requirement for these four posts.
  • Candidature at all stages is provisional, subject to satisfying the eligibility conditions.

Candidates should read the official notification for the disability-specific suitability of each post.

UPSC Age Limit 2026

The age limit differs by post. The age limit shown is the normal limit for EWS/UR candidates and the relaxed limit for SC/OBC candidates where printed. The age is further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD. The notice sets the closing date for online applications as the date for determining eligibility; for Scientist 'B' age and similar conditions, the original closing date 03.07.2026 prevails.

Post Age Limit
Dental Surgeon 35 years for UR, 35 years for EWS, and 40 years for SC
Ayurveda Physician 35 years for UR and 35 years for EWS
Homeopathic Physician 35 years for EWS
Scientist 'B' 35 years for UR/EWS, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC

Age Relaxation

Category Relaxation
SC/ST/OBC/PwBD (vacancies reserved for them) Up to five years for SC/ST, up to three years for OBC, up to ten years for PwBD
PwBD 10 years in the upper age limit for posts identified suitable for the disability (SC/ST get maximum 15 years including 5 years for their category; OBC maximum up to 13 years); applicant's maximum age on the closing date must not exceed 56 years; minimum 40% disability
Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers including ECOs/SSCOs Five years, if continuous service in the Armed Forces on the closing date is not less than six months after attestation (ECO/SSCO conditions apply as printed)
Central/UT Government servants Up to 5 years (10 years for SC/ST and 8 years for OBC in respect of posts reserved for them), with 3 years continuous service in Central Government in the same line or an allied cadre; decision rests with the Commission

UPSC Salary 2026

Post Pay Level Pay Scale
Dental Surgeon Level 10 Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Ayurveda Physician Level 10 plus NPA Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Homeopathic Physician Level 10 plus NPA Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Scientist 'B' Level 10 Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC

For the Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician posts, private practice of any kind is prohibited, for which non-practicing allowance (NPA) is allowed. The notice prints no rupee amount.

UPSC Application Fee 2026

Category Fee
Candidates other than Female/SC/ST/PwBD (OBC, EWS and Unreserved male candidates pay the full fee) Rs. 25/- (Rupees Twenty five)
SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates of any community No fee

The fee is paid by Visa/Master/Rupay Credit/Debit Card/UPI Payment or by internet banking of any Bank, and the payment mode must be opted for up to the closing date/time. Applications without the prescribed fee are summarily rejected, and no representation is entertained. Fee once paid is not refunded under any circumstance and cannot be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

UPSC Selection Process 2026

Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the basis of the information in their online applications and their performance in the Recruitment Test (RT), if held. The stages in order are:

  1. Shortlisting based on the online application, with a Recruitment Test if held.
  2. Interview.
  • If applications are large, the Commission may restrict the number called for interview by desirable qualification, higher qualification, higher experience, counting experience before or after the essential qualification, invoking experience even where none is prescribed, or by holding a Recruitment Test.
  • Minimum suitability in the interview, out of 100 marks: UR-50, OBC-45, SC/ST/PH-40.
  • Where an RT is followed by an interview, a candidate must reach the minimum suitability for the category at both stages. The RT minimum is decided by the Commission case to case.
  • The date of the interview, for which shortlisted candidates bring the print-out of the online application and other documents, will be intimated separately.
  • If a Recruitment Test forms part of selection, it will ordinarily be held at Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi and Visakhapatnam. The list is subject to change.

UPSC Job Description 2026

Dental Surgeon

  • Looks after OPD and indoor patients in Safdarjung Hospital, Dr. RML Hospital and RHTC Najafgarh.
  • Medical attendance with treatment of Central Government employees, members of their families, Central Government Pensioners and other beneficiaries covered by the Central Government Health Scheme.
  • Any other duties that may be assigned from time to time.

Ayurveda Physician

  • To diagnose and treat patients in OPD/IPD.
  • Administration of the Ayurveda Unit of which he/she is put in-charge.
  • To attend health Camps/Melas organized by NDMC/Govt. of NCT of Delhi/Govt. of India.
  • To perform any other duties assigned by the Director (AYUSH) from time to time.

Homeopathic Physician

  • To diagnose and treat patients in OPD/IPD.
  • Administration of the Homoeopathy Unit of which he/she is put in-charge.
  • To attend health Camps/Melas organized by NDMC/Govt. of NCT of Delhi/Govt. of India.
  • To perform any other duties assigned by the Director (AYUSH) from time to time.

Scientist 'B'

  • To undertake research on floristic / taxonomic revisions.
  • To identify plants.
  • To prepare proper scientific reports on field or herbarium specimens.
  • To undertake field excursions.
  • To supervise the work of Scientific Asstt. & Technical Asstt.

How to Apply Online for UPSC Recruitment 2026

  1. Go to the Commission's website https://upsconline.nic.in and read the General instructions, Profile/Module-wise instructions and instructions for uploading documents on the menu bar of the home page.
  2. Register on the portal to get a Universal Registration Number (URN), giving the details of one Photo ID Card (Aadhaar is strongly advised) in the URN profile.
  3. Fill the Common Application Form (CAF), uploading a photograph and capturing a live photograph, and uploading three signatures made one below the other in black ink on plain white paper.
  4. Fill the post/vacancy-specific module for the advertised post and upload, in pdf, the documents supporting each claim (date of birth, category, disability, qualification, experience, age relaxation).
  5. Pay the fee of Rs. 25/- by card, UPI or net banking if not exempted.
  6. Submit the application by 1800 hrs on 04-12-2026 and take a print-out of the finally submitted application. An Application Number is generated; keep it with the URN for communication.
  • Failure to provide the required information/documents along with the CAF cancels candidature for the post.
  • Candidates are not required to send printouts or documents by post or by hand. They bring them if called for interview.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the closing date.

Documents Required

  • Matriculation/10th certificate or mark sheet showing date of birth.
  • Degree/Diploma certificate; if unavailable, a provisional certificate with mark sheets for all academic years.
  • Order/letter on equivalent qualification, if one is claimed as equivalent.
  • Experience certificate in the prescribed proforma from the Head of Organisation, where claimed. Pay slips, resumes, appointment letters, relieving letters and unsigned experience certificates must not be uploaded in the Document Upload Module.
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma for SC/ST/OBC; OBC candidates also a declaration of non-creamy layer status.
  • Certificate of Disability in the prescribed proforma for PwBD candidates.
  • Age relaxation certificates for Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers, or Central/UT Government employees (issued after the date of advertisement).
  • Name-change documents, if the name has changed after matriculation.
  • Certificates for professional registration, language, publications, NET, GATE, conference and internship claims, where made.

Documents in a language other than Hindi or English need a transcript attested by a Gazetted officer or notary.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Scientist 'B' was advertised on 13.06.2026 as Advertisement No. 06/2026 (Vacancy No. 26060683213, closing date 03.07.2026) and is re-advertised under Advertisement No. 13/2026 with changed PwBD suitability.
  • Scientist 'B' vacancies are now identified as suitable for PwBD candidates in the Hard of Hearing (HH), Specific Learning Disability (SLD), Mental Illness (MI) and Multiple Disability (MD) categories. These were not identified earlier.
  • Candidates who already applied against Advertisement No. 06/2026 need not apply again. They may edit their existing applications. If they retain them unchanged, the data is preserved and merged with the new advertisement.
  • Applications cannot be withdrawn, and no correction is allowed in the application form after submission.
  • The URN profile has a one-time edit facility. Changes do not affect applications already submitted.
  • All correspondence is by e-mail only, so candidates must give a correct and active e-mail address. The interview schedule is e-mailed and posted on the Commission's website.
  • Candidates shortlisted for interview must send self-attested copies of documents as and when demanded. At the interview they must bring the print-out and the original documents. Failure to present them disqualifies the candidate and bars reimbursement of travelling expenses.
  • False information may lead to rejection and debarment from UPSC examinations or Central Government employment, permanently or for a specified period.
  • Dental Surgeon: all vacancies are permanent but are filled on temporary basis. Appointees are confirmed after probation of one year.
  • Scientist 'B' probation is two years, and a mandatory induction training of at least two weeks is needed for successful completion.
  • Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician: probation is one year.
  • Persons in regular Government service must declare that they have informed their Head of Office in writing about applying.

PrecizionIQ, a private company developing a metabolomics-based prenatal test to detect chromosomal aneuploidies, has a role brief for a Research Assistant in Metabolomics in India. The essential qualification is a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Biochemistry, Genetics, Biotechnology or a related life science, or a B.Tech. in Biotechnology, with hands-on experience in chromatography, mass spectrometry or comparable analytical techniques. Applicants send a CV and a short note by email, and the last date is 31 March 2027. This is a private-sector job, not a government post.

The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the pay, the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

About PrecizionIQ

PrecizionIQ is developing a metabolomics-based prenatal test to detect chromosomal aneuploidies. In its lab, researchers prepare samples, analyse data and help decide which experiment to run next. The Research Assistant receives training in the lab's metabolomics wet-lab and data analysis methods, from metabolite extraction through interpretation of results. The role reports to the Research Supervisor.

Who Can Apply

Essential qualification and skills

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Biochemistry, Genetics, Biotechnology, or a related life science, or B.Tech. in Biotechnology. Hands-on wet-lab experience may come from a dissertation, internship, or research role.
  • A good understanding of chemical separation, including chromatography, and the principles of mass spectrometry. Hands-on experience with these or comparable analytical techniques is required.
  • Sound laboratory practice, including accurate pipetting, sample labelling and record-keeping, and the ability to explain the purpose of controls and replicates.
  • The ability to explain how you would analyse experimental data, choose an appropriate figure, write its legend, and describe the analysis in a methods section.

Desirable experience

  • Prior work in metabolomics, familiarity with metabolite extraction, or training in blood sample handling.

For the full eligibility, refer to the official notification.

PrecizionIQ Research Assistant in Metabolomics Job Description

  • Prepare and track biological samples using current standard operating procedures, and keep records that allow a colleague to trace each figure back to the samples and analysis.
  • Analyse data and, with training, prepare publication-quality figures, legends and methods. Present results, their limitations and a proposed next step to the team.
  • Investigate unexpected results and propose experiments or changes to standard operating procedures. Review proposals with the supervisor each week before implementing changes.
  • Each Friday, bring a proposed schedule for the following week and agree priorities with the supervisor. Follow through on the plan, coordinate shared work respectfully with colleagues, and flag obstacles early.

The notice describes success in the role as building reliable wet-lab and data analysis skills, maintaining traceable records, communicating results and limitations clearly, and contributing next-step proposals with the supervisor's guidance.

How to Apply for PrecizionIQ Research Assistant in Metabolomics

  1. Prepare your CV.
  2. Write a short note describing your relevant laboratory, analytical, or research experience.
  3. Send both to PrecizionIQ by email before 31 March 2027. The email address is not specified in the notice.
  4. Leave out confidential information from a current or former employer.

Documents named in the notice: CV and a short note on relevant laboratory, analytical, or research experience.

Important Instructions

  • Do not include confidential information from a current or former employer in the CV or note.
  • The notice states that PrecizionIQ is an equal opportunity employer.
  • The type of employment (full-time or other) is not specified in the notice.

THDC India Limited (THDCIL), Across India, has invited applications for 13 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. 09/2026. The posts include Field Officer (Level I) in discipline of Law, Field Engineer (Level I) in discipline of Safety, Field Engineer (Level-I) in discipline of Structural Engineering, Field Engineer (Level-I) in discipline of Geo-Technical Engineering. According to the official notice released on 26 November 2026, the Online Personality Test will be conducted on 30 November 2026 at 1:00 PM in Remote Proctored Mode (RPA Mode). Update: The last date to apply has been extended to 08 December 2026.

The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is hiring one Cooperative Intern for Diu District for one year only. The bank is doing this under NABARD's directions. Applicants need an MBA or equivalent in Marketing, Cooperative, Agri Business or Rural Development Management and must be 21 to 30 years old. The internship pays a consolidated Rs.25,000 a month. Send your bio-data on plain paper so that it reaches the bank's Head Office in Nani Daman by 05:00 PM on 08 December 2026.

DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Recruitment 2026 Overview

DetailInformation
OrganisationThe Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd.
Notification number01/2026-27
PostCooperative Intern
Total vacancies1
PlaceDiu District
RemunerationRs.25,000 per month (consolidated)
How to applyOffline: bio-data on plain paper, sent to the Head Office
Notice date28.10.2026
Last date08.12.2026 (05:00 PM)
WebsiteDaman & Diu State Co-operative Bank website

The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

About DDSCBL

The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is a state co-operative bank licensed by the RBI (Licence No. Dos. RO (AH). REG/LIC.S-2187/04.36.000/2023-24 dated 07 March 2024). Its Head Office is in Dilip Nagar, Nani Daman, and its Administration Department issued this notice. You can reach that department on 0260 2255984 and 2255985, or by email at [email protected]. The internship is part of NABARD's scheme for engaging Cooperative Interns to strengthen cooperatives. The National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) runs the scheme, NABARD monitors it and state co-operative banks carry it out.

DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Vacancy Details 2026

PostVacanciesPay
Cooperative Intern (Diu District)1Rs.25,000 per month (consolidated)

The bank pays TA/DA from its own funds. The Rs.25,000 remuneration is reimbursed from the Cooperative Education Fund of the Ministry of Cooperation through NCDC.

DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Eligibility 2026

Age Limit

You must be at least 21 years old and no older than 30.

Educational Qualification

  • MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management / Cooperative Management / Agri Business Management / Rural Development Management.
  • Essential: proficiency in computer.

The bank asks candidates to read the full eligibility criteria and essential requirements in NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024, which comes with the official notification, before applying.

Duties of the Cooperative Intern

  • Work with PACS and other primary cooperatives and guide them in carrying out the initiatives of the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India.
  • Solve day-to-day problems PACS face with computerisation, business plans, projects, financing and various approvals.
  • Prepare and share a weekly status report on these initiatives, in coordination with the DCCB/StCB.

The scheme aims to take the cooperative movement down to the grassroots. It also lets professional graduates learn how cooperatives work in practice and builds a pool of experienced cooperative professionals.

Important Dates

EventDate
Notification date28.10.2026
Last date for applications to reach the Head Office08.12.2026, 05:00 PM
NABARD circular on the scheme15.03.2024

Service Conditions

  • This is purely an internship programme for one year only. NCDC funds it, and the bank carries no liability.
  • It is not an appointment or employment and does not promise one. No intern has any right or claim to a job with the bank because of this internship.
  • The internship is full-time. The intern must keep the bank's working hours.
  • The bank may post or transfer interns according to its functional needs.
  • Interns get 10 days of Casual Leave for the year and no other leave. Any other leave is treated as "Leave without remuneration". The bank's holidays may apply to interns.
  • The internship may end at any time, with no financial benefit, if performance is not satisfactory or the intern is absent without the bank's permission. The bank may also end it at any time without giving a reason.
  • Interns must keep all documents, reports and information confidential. Breaking this rule has legal consequences.
  • Interns may not deal with or represent the bank to print, electronic or social media. They may not post their work on social media without express permission from the competent authority.
  • Interns must follow the rules and regulations of the bank and behave professionally with the bank and the public.

How to Apply for DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Recruitment 2026

  1. Read the official notification and NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024 on the bank's website.
  2. Write your application on plain paper with your complete bio-data.
  3. Attach the documents listed below.
  4. Address it to: The General Manager (ADM), The Daman & Diu State Cooperative Bank Ltd., Head Office- H. No. 14/54, 1st Floor, Dilipnagar, Nani Daman- 396210.
  5. Make sure it reaches the Head Office by 05:00 PM on 08 December 2026. Applications that arrive after that will be rejected outright.

Documents to Enclose

  • Self-attested copies of certificates showing your age, eligibility, educational qualification and experience
  • A recent coloured passport-size photograph

Any updates on this recruitment will be posted on the bank's website.

Uttarakhand Gramin Bank (UGB), Dehradun has invited applications from retired officers of Scale III to Scale V of UGB, SBI, any other RRB sponsored by SBI or any commercial bank for 10 Concurrent Auditor posts on contract for up to 12 months. Applications are sent by post or delivered by hand to The General Manager (Administration) at the Head Office in Dehradun. The last date for submission at that address is 15 December 2026.

UGB Concurrent Auditor at a Glance

ParticularsDetails
OrganisationUttarakhand Gramin Bank, Dehradun
Post(s)Concurrent Auditor (contractual)
Vacancies10

QualificationRetired officer of Scale III to Scale V from UGB, SBI, any other RRB sponsored by SBI or any commercial bank
Job LocationSelected branches, AMSHs and CPCs in and around 10 centres in Uttarakhand
Apply ByPost or by hand
Last Date15.12.2026 (last date for submission at the Head Office address)

The official notification does not specify the application fee.

About the Bank

Uttarakhand Gramin Bank is a bank with its Head Office at 8 A, IT Park, Dehradun. The Concurrent Audit is to be conducted in selected branches, AMSHs and CPCs in and around ten centres. The selected auditors will form a pool available with the Chief Inspector at Head Office, who allocates the auditee units and gives the necessary instructions.

Where and How to Send

Download the application from the Bank's website www.ukgb.bank.in. The application format is also printed in the notice. Send it by post or deliver it by hand to:

The General Manager (Administration), Uttarakhand Gramin Bank, Head Office – 8 A, IT PARK, Opposite SIDCUL, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun - 248 013

The last date for submission at this address is 15.12.2026. Applications received after the last date will not be entertained. The notice does not mention an envelope superscription, a postal mode or an application email address.

The application asks for these details:

  • Name, father's name and date of birth.
  • Bank and branch office from which the applicant retired, the post/scale held at retirement, and the date of retirement. A certificate in Annexure – A is required if the applicant did not retire from Uttarakhand Gramin Bank.
  • PF No./Employee No., present residence with full postal address, permanent address, mobile/landline number and email ID.
  • Educational qualification and JAIIB/CAIIB status.
  • Details of the last 3 postings before retirement with dates.
  • Experience in loans, audit or NPA follow-up, current work if any, and any disciplinary action during service.
  • KYC details (Aadhaar No. and PAN No.), the period of medical leave in the year before retirement, and the full address of the usual place of residence if empanelled.
  • Experience as Regional Manager or Branch Manager in years and months.

The applicant also states that he or she agrees to work anywhere in the Bank's area of operation, and declares that the information is true, failing which the candidature may be cancelled.
