Eligibility

  • The applicant must be a retired (superannuated) officer of Scale III to Scale V from UGB, SBI, any other RRB sponsored by SBI or any commercial bank. Officers going to superannuate within the next 6 months can also apply.
  • Experience: minimum 2 years of Branch Manager/Regional Manager assignment with a satisfactory track record, and good experience in operation, preferably from an Audit background.
  • Age: below 69 years at the time of renewal of the contract.
  • The gap from the date of superannuation to the date of first appointment must not be more than 2 years. For later renewals there should not be a gap of one year.
  • The officer must never have been penalised in disciplinary proceedings while in active service, except punishment by way of censure.
  • The officer must be medically fit, certified by the sponsor Bank's doctor with all normal pathological tests, and fluent in both Hindi and English.
  • Those on medical leave exceeding four months in the last year of service are not eligible to apply.

The notice does not name any educational qualification. The official notification should be checked for the eligibility details of the post.

Remuneration

  • Home-centre: a fixed sum of Rs 40,000 per month. The auditor may claim reimbursement of travelling expenses not exceeding Rs 4,000 per month on the basis of a certificate or petrol bill.
  • Non Home-centre: a fixed sum of Rs 45,000 per month. Stay expenses are reimbursable up to a maximum of Rs 12,000 per month on production of a rent agreement. Up to a maximum of Rs 6,000 per month can also be claimed for conveyance on an actual or certificate basis.
  • TDS/Income Tax rules apply as per the IT Act.
  • The remuneration was fixed with the approval of the Board.

Enclosures

Documents named in the notice:

  • Annexure – A certificate on the Bank's letter head, signed by an authorised signatory with seal and date, if the applicant did not retire from UGB. It records the retirement date and scale, years as Branch Manager/Regional Manager and as an Auditor, any major penalty, and the days of medical leave in the last year of service.
  • KYC details with Aadhaar No. and PAN No., as asked in the application form.

Selection Process

The notice says the process of selection is "As per policy guidelines" and describes no stage. It mentions that no TA/DA/Leave is granted for appearing in an interview. Selected auditors will form a pool with the Chief Inspector at Head Office.

Important Instructions

  • The appointment initially stands for one year from the date of appointment. The agreement may be extended for the next 12 months on the same terms and conditions, subject to a satisfactory annual performance review.
  • The proposed maximum tenure is 5 years, subject to annual review.
  • The successful candidate must execute the Contract within the timeline and implement it from the specified date, once the Bank intimates acceptance of the application.
  • The successful candidate signs an Agreement and must pay the required stamp duty as per Stamp laws in force in Uttarakhand.
  • The Bank may cut or extend the timeline, accept or reject any application or all offers without assigning a reason, alter the schedule or change the process.
  • No reimbursement of cost of any type will be paid to any person submitting an application.
  • No TA/DA/Leave will be granted to a working or retired official for appearing in interview.
  • More details are on the Bank's website www.ukgb.bank.in under "Careers" at the bottom.

2. Interview

Candidates shortlisted based on their online test performance will be called for an interview. The interview carries 100 marks, and the qualifying marks will be decided by SBI.

3. Final Merit List

The marks obtained in the online written examination and interview will be normalised using 70:30 weightage. The category-wise merit list will be prepared in descending order of the combined normalised scores. If candidates obtain identical marks at the cut-off point, they will be ranked according to age in descending order.

About NaBFID

The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) has been set up under an Act of Parliament, the NaBFID Act, 2021, as the principal entity for infrastructure financing in the country. It is regulated and supervised as an All-India Financial Institution (AIFI) by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). According to the notice, NaBFID supports infrastructure funding by developing innovative financing instruments, bond and derivatives markets, and data-driven risk management.

Where and How to Send

NaBFID accepts applications for this post only by email. The notice states that no other mode of application will be accepted and hard copies are not to be sent.

  1. Visit the link given against the job position for the detailed role description.
  2. Prepare your CV, including a passport sized photograph.
  3. Send the CV by email to [email protected].
  4. Write the subject line strictly as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF <Job Code>". The job code printed for this post is NABFID/EVP/16.
  5. Make sure the email is received on or before 1 December 2026 by 06:00 pm IST.

Candidates should have a valid email ID and keep it active till the declaration of result, as call letters and interview advice will be sent by email.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

The advertisement covers a single post in the grade of Executive Vice President: Sl. No. 01, EVP & Head- Market Risk, ALM & Enterprise Risk, Job Code NABFID/EVP/16, 1 vacancy (UR).

Educational Qualification

  • Graduate /Postgraduate in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution or a Chartered Account.
  • Preferred: Certification in Financial Risk Management from Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP) OR Professional Risk Management Certification from PRIMA Institute.

Experience

  • Minimum 20 years of experience in financial sector.
  • Of these, 5 years should be in risk management function (in RBI regulated entity).
  • Of these 5 years, 2 years should be at senior management level.
  • Experience in the infrastructure domain will be preferred.

Age Limit

The age limit is 55 years and below, as on the date of advertisement. After applying all relaxations in terms of age, the maximum age of candidates shall not exceed 55 years. Candidates should satisfy themselves about their eligibility as on the cut-off date, 3 November 2026.

Nationality

The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens.

Pay and Terms of Engagement

  • Remuneration will be offered based on qualifications, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark, and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. No fixed amount is printed in the notice.
  • Contractual engagement will be for a period of 5 years, which may be renewed for additional terms at the discretion of the Bank.
  • Location of position: Mumbai. Selected candidates may be posted in the Bank's establishment in Mumbai/New Delhi/Anywhere in India, as per the Bank's discretion and requirement.
  • Engagement of the selected candidate is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank.

Candidates should check the detailed role description linked in the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

NaBFID Recruitment 2026 Job Description

  • Responsible for developing and implementing NaBFID's enterprise-wide risk framework.
  • Ensuring that the Bank's portfolio is built within the defined risk parameters.
  • Building appropriate mechanisms to measure risk.
  • Providing advice and structuring risk mitigation into the business operations at NaBFID.

A detailed role description is available as a separate document on the NaBFID website, linked from the notice.

Enclosures

  • CV including a passport sized photograph (with the email application).
  • No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview, for candidates serving in Govt./Quasi Govt. offices, Public Sector undertakings including Nationalised Banks and Financial Institutions.
  • Details of criminal case(s) pending, if any, at the time of interview.
  • Proper relieving letters from the employer at the time of taking up the appointment, in case of selection.

Selection Process

Applications will be screened and shortlisted on the basis of eligibility and relevant experience, and the requisite number of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

  • Screening and shortlisting: based on eligibility and relevant experience. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.
  • Additional assessment: shortlisted candidates may undergo psychometric tests and/or assessment centre and/or any other selection method deemed suitable by NaBFID, in addition to the personal interview.
  • Personal Interview: conducted by a committee constituted for this purpose.
  • Final selection: made on the basis of eligibility, experience, qualification and performance during the Personal Interview. Selection is solely at the discretion of NaBFID's Selection Committee, and its decision will be final.

The intimation or call letter for interview will be sent by email or uploaded to the Bank's website. No hard copy of the interview letter will be shared.

The Akola Janata Commercial Co-Operative Bank Ltd., Akola has invited applications for nine posts: Banking Law Officer, CA, MBA, Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Data Base Administrator (DBA), IT Security & Cybersecurity Officer, IT Compliance, Risk & Documentation Officer, Cloud & Data Center Management Officer and Banking Business Analyst & IT Automation Officer. Applications go in a sealed envelope to the Chief Executive Officer at Akola, to be sent before December 10, 2026.

Akola Janata Bank Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

ParticularsDetails
OrganisationThe Akola Janata Commercial Co-Operative Bank Ltd., Akola
Post(s)Banking Law Officer, CA, MBA, CISO, DBA and other posts (9 posts in all)
QualificationVaries by post: LLB or LLM, CA, MBA in Finance, BE/B.Tech and others
Job LocationAkola
Apply ByPost, in a sealed envelope
Last DateBefore December 10, 2026

The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit, the pay or the application fee.

About Akola Janata Bank

The Akola Janata Commercial Co-Operative Bank Ltd. is a cooperative bank based in Akola, Maharashtra. Its notice is headed "Human Resources Requirement" and invites applications from experienced professionals for legal, investment and loan, and IT roles.

Where and How to Send

Send the application to: Chief Executive Officer, The Akola Janata Commercial Cooperative Bank Ltd., Akola, "Janvaibhav", Old Cotton Market, Akola (MS) 444001.

  • Use a sealed envelope with "Post Applied For ___________" written on it, filling in the post.
  • The application must go before December 10, 2026. The notice does not say whether this is a dispatch or a receipt deadline, and does not name the postal mode.
  • No separate application form is attached to the notice; the application is made with a detailed resume.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

The notice does not print pay for any post. Applicants must state their expected salary in the envelope. Experience required, post by post:

PostDepartmentExperience
Banking Law OfficerLegal Department5 years of Loan NPA Recovery in banks
CAInvestment / Loan Department3 years
MBAInvestment / Loan Department3 years
Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)IT Department5 years
Data Base Administrator (DBA)IT Department3 years
IT Security & Cybersecurity OfficerIT Department3 years
IT Compliance, Risk & Documentation OfficerIT Department3 years
Cloud & Data Center Management OfficerIT Department3 years
Banking Business Analyst & IT Automation OfficerIT Department3 years

Banking Law Officer

  • Educational qualification: LLB or LLM.
  • Experience: 5 years of experience of Loan NPA Recovery in banks.

CA

  • Educational qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA).
  • Investments: should have worked in a bank in a key position of the Investment Department and must have handled various types of investment instruments.
  • Loans: should have worked in a bank in a key position of the Credit Department.

MBA

  • Educational qualification: MBA in Finance from campus of a reputed institute.
  • Experience: should have worked in a bank in a key position of Investments or Loans.

Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

  • Educational qualification: BE/B.Tech in Information Technology, Computer Science or Electronics.
  • Cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM, CRISC and CCSP will be preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years of similar role in a banking environment; should have implemented cyber security controls of at least Level III bank as per RBI circular on Cybersecurity.

Technical / functional knowledge required:

  • Network security, firewall, endpoint protection and antivirus management.
  • Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT) follow-up.
  • User access control, multi-factor authentication and privileged access management.
  • Security logs, incident response, threat monitoring and escalation.
  • Backup security, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Security controls for CBS, digital banking and payment systems.
  • Cybersecurity requirements applicable to cooperative banks under relevant RBI directions.

Data Base Administrator (DBA)

  • Educational qualification: BE/B.Tech in Information Technology, Computer Science or Electronics.
  • With one of: Certified PostgreSQL DBA (CPSDBA) from PostgreSQLCert; Microsoft Certified: Database Administrator; Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) – Oracle Database Administrator; IBM Certified Administrator – Db2.
  • Experience: 3 years.

Technical / functional knowledge required (hybrid skills across on-prem SQL Server and cloud platforms):

  • Core administration, storage, configuration.
  • Backup/restore and disaster recovery.
  • Performance tuning (indexes, Query Store, wait stats).
  • Security and auditing.
  • Automation (PowerShell, SQL Agent).
  • Monitoring and incident response.

IT Security & Cybersecurity Officer

  • Educational qualification: BE/B.Tech in Information Technology, Computer Science or Electronics.
  • MCA, M.Sc. Computer Science or an equivalent relevant qualification.
  • Cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM, CRISC and CCSP will be preferred.
  • Experience: 3 years.
  • Technical / functional knowledge required: the same seven areas as listed for the CISO post (network security to cooperative bank cybersecurity requirements under RBI directions).

IT Compliance, Risk & Documentation Officer

  • Educational qualification: BE/B.Tech in Information Technology or Computer Science.
  • MCA, MBA in Information Systems or a relevant postgraduate qualification.
  • IT audit, risk management or regulatory compliance training preferred.
  • Experience: should have experience in the banking sector, and in drafting of policies, agreements, SLAs and review of vendor SLAs.

Technical / functional knowledge required:

  • RBI IT, cybersecurity and outsourcing requirements applicable to the bank.
  • CSITE audit preparation and closure of audit observations.
  • DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025.
  • IT policies, SOPs, risk registers and control documentation.
  • Vendor risk assessment and third-party service management.
  • Data inventory, retention, access reviews and privacy controls.
  • Evidence management for internal, external and regulatory audits.

Cloud & Data Center Management Officer

  • Educational qualification: BE/B.Tech in IT, Computer Science or Electronics and Telecommunication.
  • MCA, M.Sc. IT or an equivalent relevant qualification.
  • Cloud certification in AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is preferred.
  • Relevant data center, infrastructure or systems administration training is an advantage.
  • Experience: 3 years; preferably experience of handling cloud infrastructure of a bank, relevant data center or systems administration.

Technical knowledge required:

  • Cloud infrastructure, virtual machines, storage and network configuration.
  • Windows Server and Linux administration.
  • Data center monitoring, server health and capacity planning.
  • Virtualization platforms, storage systems and backup solutions.
  • Cloud identity and access management, MFA and least-privilege access.
  • Encryption, key management and secure cloud configuration.
  • Backup validation, replication, failover and disaster recovery testing.
  • Infrastructure monitoring, log retention and alert escalation.
  • Vendor SLA management, infrastructure inventory and technology refresh planning.
  • Cloud cost monitoring, resource utilization and capacity forecasting.

Banking Business Analyst & IT Automation Officer

  • Educational qualification: BE/B.Tech in Information Technology or Computer Science.
  • MCA, M.Sc. Computer Science or an equivalent relevant qualification.
  • Business analysis, SQL, reporting or automation training preferred.
  • Experience: 3 years; should have experience of banking system automations.

Technical / functional knowledge required:

  • Banking operations, CBS workflows and branch processes.
  • NPCI products.
  • MSSQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL and SSRS reporting.
  • Excel, Power Query and Power BI.
  • Requirements gathering, process mapping and gap analysis.
  • User acceptance testing, test cases, defect tracking and release validation.
  • Reconciliation, management information systems and data quality.
  • Workflow automation and basic scripting.

Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

Enclosures

  • Application with a detailed resume.
  • Candidate photograph.
  • Photocopies of relevant certificates.
  • Work experience details.
  • Expected salary.

OrganisationCanara Bank
Post(s)Doctor

QualificationMBBS with minimum 10 years experience, OR MD or PG degree with minimum 7 years of post-qualification experience

About Canara Bank

Canara Bank is a bank with its Head Office at #112, J C Road, Bengaluru. This engagement is for a dispensary at the Bank's H.O. Annex, National Games Village, Koramangala, Bengaluru. The dispensary is meant to give immediate medical consultation and treatment for common diseases to employees, their dependents and retired employees.

Where and How to Send

The filled-in application, duly signed and with enclosures, may be submitted by email or speed post. The email or document must be superscribed 'Application for engaging Doctor'.

  • Email: [email protected]
  • Postal address: Canara Bank, HOSA Section, H R Wing, Head Office, #112, J C Road, Bengaluru – 560002
  • Form: "Application for engaging Doctor at Canara Bank, H.O. Annex, National Games Village, Koramangala, Bengaluru", printed on the first page of the notice.

The form asks for these details:

  • Name, date of birth and qualification, with specialisation if any.
  • Permanent address and communication address, each with the S/o, D/o or W/o detail.
  • Email id, telephone and mobile number.
  • Details of the last 3 places of experience: institution, dates from and upto, job handled and reason for exit.
  • Expected remuneration per month, in figures and words.
  • Preferred time slot of 2 hours, continuous without any breaks.
  • A declaration with place, date and signature.

The declaration says that if any information is found false or incorrect, action may be initiated as deemed fit, including termination.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

The notice invites applications for one post, Doctor.

  • Qualification: MBBS with a minimum of 10 years experience, OR an MD or PG degree with a minimum of 7 years of post-qualification experience.
  • Pay: a consolidated remuneration per month. Applicants state their expected monthly remuneration in the form.
  • Time slot: a continuous 2-hour slot, falling between 11.00 AM and 5.00 PM, Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays. Applicants state the preferred slot in the form.

The age limit is not given in the notice. Candidates should refer to the official notification for any further eligibility details.

Canara Bank Doctor Job Description

  • The dispensary functions on all working days of the Bank for not less than 2 hours per day.
  • The 2-hour time slot is fixed during initiation and there is no change.
  • The Bank provides the premises for the dispensary, along with basic amenities.
  • Minimum essential medicines are provided for common problems like fever, cough and cold, or other minor health problems.
  • For any other medicine, the Doctor gives a prescription for employees to buy in the market at their own cost.
  • The dispensary gives immediate medical consultation and treatment for common diseases to employees, dependents of employees and retired employees.

Enclosures

  • Self-attested copy of MBBS with minimum 10 years experience, or of the MD or PG degree with a minimum of 7 years of post-qualification experience.
  • Two references from respectable persons.

Important Instructions

  • The remuneration is remitted to the Doctor's account on or before the 5th of the succeeding month, as per the account details provided.
  • If the Doctor does not attend continuously, the proportionate remuneration is deducted for the days not attended.
  • Applicable TDS is deducted and remitted as per the PAN details provided.
  • Additional expenses incurred for communications, travel etc. are not payable.
  • The Doctor's performance is reviewed quarterly, taking into account the views of the employees who use the dispensary.
  • If deficiencies or attitudinal problems are noted, reported or observed, the Bank may decide to stop the engagement and engage another Doctor in his or her place.
  • The Bank's decision on shortlisting and selection is final, and no further correspondence is entertained.
  • The Bank reserves the right to alter, change or cancel the entire process without assigning any reason and without previous notice.

The post of Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Nizamabad DCCB carries a consolidated pay of Rs.2,60,000 per month for a CEO selected from outside the Apex Bank and the DCCBs. Telangana State Co-operative Apex Bank Ltd (TGCAB), a State Govt. Partnered Scheduled Bank, has invited applications for the post on contract/deputation basis for a period of at least 3 years. Applicants need at least 8 years' experience at Middle/Senior level (Scale III and above) in the Banking Sector, and applications in a closed cover must be received at the TGCAB Head Office, Hyderabad, before 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026.

TGCAB Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

Particulars Details
Organisation Telangana State Co-operative Apex Bank Ltd (TGCAB)
Advertisement No. TGCAB/HRMD/F.No.CF/518
Post Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Nizamabad DCCB
Pay Rs.2,60,000 per month consolidated (candidates selected from outside); pay protection plus CEO Allowance for in-service candidates
Contract Term At least 3 years, on deputation/contract basis
Experience Required At least 8 years at Middle/Senior level (Scale III and above) in the Banking Sector
Job Location Nizamabad DCCB
How to Apply Prescribed application format with D.D. for Rs.1000/-, sent in a closed cover to the Managing Director, TGCAB, Hyderabad
Last Date 04.12.2026, before 5.00 PM (last date for receipt)

The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies.

About TGCAB

Telangana State Co-operative Apex Bank Ltd is described in its notification as a State Govt. Partnered Scheduled Bank, with its Head Office at Troop Bazar, Hyderabad. The notice is issued by its Managing Director under reference TGCAB/HRMD/F.No.CF/518 dated 20.11.2026. The post is that of CEO of Nizamabad DCCB, and the candidate must meet the Fit and Proper Criteria prescribed by the RBI/NABARD.

Who Can Apply

Qualification (at least one of)

  • Graduate with CAIIB/DBF/Diploma in Cooperative Business Management or equivalent qualifications; or
  • Chartered/Cost Accountant; or
  • Post Graduate in any discipline.

Experience

  • At least Eight (8) years of work experience at the Middle/Senior level (Scale III and above) in the Banking Sector.
  • Documentary evidence of having worked at the Middle/Senior level for the required period must be enclosed.

Age Limit

The applicant shall not be above 62 years of age as on the date of notification. The notification is dated 20 November 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

Other Conditions

  • Proficiency in Telugu is essential.
  • Candidates who meet the Fit and Proper Criteria and are presently working in other Banks should apply through Proper Channel. They may submit advance copies before the last date to avoid delay in forwarding.
  • Candidates who have resigned or taken voluntary retirement, and are otherwise eligible under the Fit and Proper Criteria, must submit their relieving certificate and other relevant records with the application.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full Fit and Proper Criteria of the post.

Pay and Terms

  • CEOs selected from outside (candidates not in service of Apex Bank or any DCCB): a consolidated pay of Rs.2,60,000/- per month, subject to deduction of applicable taxes or other statutory deductions, if any.
  • CEOs selected from in-service candidates (working in Apex Bank or any DCCB): pay protection is given. In addition to pay and allowances drawn in the existing cadre, a CEO Allowance @15% on Basic Pay + DA drawn in the existing cadre is extended; this allowance carries no further allowance.
  • Leave Rules, Perks and allowances are extended as per the guidelines prescribed for CEOs of DCCBs.
  • The appointment is for a period of at least 3 years on deputation/contract basis.

How to Apply for TGCAB Recruitment 2026

Applications are sent on paper by post or hand. No online application is mentioned in the notice.

  1. Download the application and the general conditions from the TGCAB website https://tgcab.bank.in or the Nizamabad DCCB website https://nizamabaddccb.bank.in. The download period is 20.11.2026 to 04.12.2026.
  2. Complete the application in the prescribed format only, and paste a recent passport size photo in the space provided.
  3. Enclose self-attested copies of certificates proving date of birth, qualifications, experience and other credentials, along with the supporting documents and testimonials.
  4. Enclose the application fee of Rs.1000/- as a D.D. drawn in favour of TGCAB, Hyderabad.
  5. Put the application in a closed cover addressed to Managing Director, Telangana State Cooperative Apex Bank Ltd. (TGCAB), Head Office, 4-1-441, Troop Bazar, Hyderabad – 500001.
  6. Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CEO, NIZAMABAD DCCB" on the cover.
  7. Make sure the application reaches TGCAB before 5.00 PM on 04.12.2026.

Documents named in the notice

  • Application in the prescribed format with a recent passport size photo pasted on it
  • Self-attested copies of proof of date of birth, qualifications, experience and other credentials
  • Documentary evidence of Middle/Senior level work for the required period
  • Relieving certificate and other relevant records, for candidates who resigned or took voluntary retirement
  • D.D. for Rs.1000/- in favour of TGCAB, Hyderabad

The notice gives the HRMD contact as 040-24685597, 559 and the email [email protected].

Important Instructions

  • Applications not complying with the conditions of Age, Qualifications, Experience, employer recommendations, etc., will be summarily rejected.
  • TGCAB reserves the right to add, delete and/or amend the conditions in the Notification, without any Notice.
  • The application fee is Rs.1000/-; the notice lists no category-wise fee or exemption.

Maharashtra State Co-operative Bank Ltd. (MSC Bank), Mumbai, will appoint one Senior Officer as a Representative of Institutional Administrator on two District Central Cooperative Banks, on contract, with posting at Nagpur. Applications are offline, sent to The Managing Director, The Maharashtra State Co-op. Bank Ltd., Fort, Mumbai, on or before 7 December 2026, under Advertisement No.08 / MSC Bank / 2026-2027.

About the Bank and the Posting

Maharashtra State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is a scheduled bank with its office at Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Smruti Bhavan, Fort, Mumbai. According to the notice, the Government of Maharashtra has appointed the bank as Institutional Administrator on Nagpur District Central Cooperative Bank and Wardha District Central Cooperative Bank.

In this regard, MSC Bank wants to appoint a Senior Officer as a Representative of Institutional Administrator on these two DCC Banks. The place of posting is Nagpur.

Where and How to Send

Interested candidates who meet the minimum eligibility criteria may submit offline applications to the undersigned on or before 7 December 2026, at this address:

The Managing Director, The Maharashtra State Co-op. Bank Ltd., Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Smruti Bhavan, 9, Maharashtra Chamber of Commerce Lane, Fort, Mumbai – 400 001.

The notice does not say whether the application should go by post, courier or by hand, and it does not prescribe any wording for the envelope. Use the application form printed with the notice:

  • Annexure-1 – the application form, with a box for a recent passport sized photograph. Sign across the photograph and do not pin or staple it.
  • Annexure-2 – a signed declaration on departmental enquiries, detention or notices from a Statutory Authority, and resignations from previous employers.

Annexure-1 asks for the post applied for, full name, date of birth, gender, age as on 01.11.2026 (years and months), category, residential address with PIN code, e-mail ID, mobile number, PAN number, Aadhar number and whether you are domiciled in Maharashtra. It then asks for educational qualifications from 10th standard onwards (board or university, year of passing, % of marks), professional qualifications (CAIIB / DBF / GDCA, certification, others), work experience with each employer (designation, dates of joining and exit, portfolio handled, level of management), achievements, two references and a list of the documents enclosed. It ends with a signed declaration that you will abide by the decisions of the Bank in all matters of this recruitment.

The bank's letterhead gives the phone number +91-22-69801000, Post Box No. 472, the email [email protected] and the website https://msc.bank.in.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

There is one post, Representative of Institutional Administrator, for a Senior Officer. The eligibility criteria printed in the notice are:

  • Maximum Age Limit: 62 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.
  • Essential Qualification: Graduate / Post Graduate in any discipline.
  • Technical qualification: CAIIB / DBF / Diploma in Cooperative Business Management or equivalent qualification. GDC&A would be preferable.
  • Experience: at least 15 years of work experience at the middle & senior level in the Rural Cooperative Banking.
  • Remuneration: will commensurate with the qualification & experience. The notice prints no pay figure.
  • Nature of appointment: purely on contract basis, initially for one year, and may be extended as per performance.

See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

  • Self-attested photocopies of relevant qualification certificates
  • Self-attested photocopies of relevant experience certificates

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) has released the SIDBI Recruitment 2026 notification for 68 Officer vacancies under Grade A and Grade B in General and Specialist Streams. The recruitment includes 63 Assistant Manager Grade A posts and 5 Manager Grade B posts across General, Hindi, Legal and Systems/Information Technology (IT) streams. Eligible candidates can apply online from 21 November 2026 through the official website, sidbi.in. The last date for submitting the application and paying the prescribed fee is 11 December 2026.

According to Advertisement No. 8/Grade 'A' and 'B'/2026-27, applicants must meet the post-specific educational qualification, relevant work experience and age requirements. The age limit is 21 to 30 years for Grade A and 25 to 33 years for Grade B as on 21 November 2026, with applicable relaxations. The selection process consists of Phase I, Phase II and an interview. The online examinations are tentatively scheduled for 27 December 2026, while interviews are expected in February 2027. Candidates should read the official notification carefully before applying because qualifications and experience requirements differ significantly between streams.

SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for SIDBI Grade A and Grade B recruitment depends on the post, educational qualification, relevant experience and age limit. Candidates should not assume that a qualification accepted for one stream is automatically valid for another.

The educational qualification and post-qualification experience cut-off date is 11 December 2026. The age eligibility cut-off date is 21 November 2026.

SIDBI Grade A and B Educational Qualification 2026

Assistant Manager Grade A - General Stream

Candidates must possess one of the following qualifications from an appropriately recognized institution:

  • Graduation in Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Administration or Engineering with at least 60% marks in aggregate, or 50% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where vacancies are reserved for them.
  • Company Secretary (CS), Cost and Management Accountant (CMA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or Chartered Accountant (CA).
  • Two-year full-time MBA or PGDM in any discipline from an institution recognized or approved by the relevant authority.

Applicants pursuing the final year of a qualifying MBA/PGDM programme may apply, subject to producing the required final marksheet and degree certificate at joining if selected.

Assistant Manager Grade A - Hindi Stream

Candidates must meet one of the following educational qualification routes:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 60% marks (55% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates), with Hindi and English studied as compulsory or elective subjects for at least two years, along with a postgraduate diploma of at least one year in translation between Hindi and English.
  • A master's degree in Hindi with at least 50% marks, with English studied as a main or elective subject for at least two years during graduation.
  • A master's degree in English with at least 50% marks, with Hindi studied as a main or elective subject for at least two years during graduation.

Candidates must be able to translate from English to Hindi and vice versa.

Assistant Manager Grade A - Legal Stream

Applicants must have a bachelor's degree in Law from a recognized university or institution with at least 50% marks in aggregate, or 45% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where applicable. Candidates must also be enrolled as advocates with the Bar Council of India.

A master's degree in Law, CS qualification and proficiency in computer applications are desirable.

Assistant Manager Grade A - Systems / IT Stream

Applicants must possess a B.E./B.Tech degree in any discipline or an MCA from a recognized institution with at least 60% marks, or 55% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where the relevant reservation applies.

Preference may be given to candidates with engineering degrees in Computer Science, Computer Technology, Information Technology, Electronics, Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied disciplines.

Relevant certifications in AI/ML, Data Science, Full Stack Application Development, information security or IT service management are desirable.

Manager Grade B - Hindi, Legal and Systems / IT Streams

Grade B applicants must satisfy the relevant specialist-stream educational qualifications:

  • Hindi: A qualifying bachelor's degree with Hindi and English plus a postgraduate translation diploma, or a master's degree in Hindi or English with the prescribed graduation-level language study requirements.
  • Legal: A recognized bachelor's degree in Law with at least 50% marks (45% for eligible reserved-category candidates where applicable) and enrolment as an advocate with the Bar Council of India.
  • Systems / IT: A recognized B.E./B.Tech degree in any discipline or MCA with at least 60% marks, or 55% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where applicable.

Grade B candidates must also possess the prescribed specialist experience. The detailed advertisement should be consulted for accepted employers, duties and technical skill requirements.

Important Experience Exception for SIDBI Grade A General Stream

The official advertisement provides an important exception for candidates holding CA or an MBA/PGDM completed through a two-year full-time programme from a recognized institution. For such candidates, the prescribed Grade A General Stream work-experience requirement is waived.

However, candidates must still satisfy the remaining eligibility conditions and qualify through SIDBI's selection process.

For other Grade A General applicants, relevant work experience must fall within the duties and organizations specified in the official notification. Experience exclusively related to personal, education, vehicle or housing loans is not accepted under the applicable lending-experience provisions.

Grade B specialist candidates should note that the advertisement specifies qualifying permanent or full-time direct contractual experience and excludes third-party payroll experience for the relevant posts.

SIDBI offers different pay scales for Assistant Manager Grade A and Manager Grade B. The official notification also provides approximate monthly gross emoluments and annual cost-to-company ranges.

The pay package includes applicable allowances and benefits under SIDBI rules. The actual amount may vary by place of posting and other applicable conditions. Gross emoluments and CTC should not be confused with take-home salary.

Probation and Posting

Selected candidates will normally undergo probation for two years, extendable up to four years at SIDBI's discretion. Officers may be posted or transferred to SIDBI offices, verticals, associates or subsidiaries according to organizational requirements.

This is an officer recruitment and not a deputation-only advertisement. A fixed deputation period is therefore not applicable.

SIDBI Grade A and B Selection Process 2026

The SIDBI Recruitment 2026 selection process comprises three stages:

  1. Phase I - Online screening/objective examination
  2. Phase II - English descriptive examination and stream-specific objective/descriptive examination
  3. Phase III - Interview

Phase I and Phase II will be conducted on the same day in a single sitting. Phase II papers will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify Phase I according to the minimum marks prescribed by SIDBI.

Documents Required for SIDBI Recruitment 2026

Candidates should keep the following documents and details available while completing the application and during subsequent verification stages:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph
  • Scanned signature in black ink
  • Scanned left thumb impression
  • Handwritten declaration in English
  • Valid personal email ID and mobile number

  • Experience certificates and relevant employment records, where applicable
  • Valid identity and date-of-birth proof

  • No Objection Certificate for specified employed candidates at the interview stage

The photograph, signature, thumb impression and handwritten declaration must follow the image and file specifications provided in the official notification. The online application process also includes live photograph capture.

SIDBI Handwritten Declaration 2026

The declaration must be written in the candidate's own handwriting in English, subject to the accessibility exception specified in the notification.

I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.

Signatures written entirely in capital letters will not be accepted. Candidates should check the detailed advertisement for the required scan specifications.

SIDBI Recruitment 2026 NOC Requirements

Candidates currently serving in Government, quasi-government offices, Public Sector Undertakings, nationalized banks and financial institutions are required to produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the interview stage.

The NOC must specifically permit the candidate to appear for the SIDBI selection interview. SIDBI states that conditional NOCs will not be accepted. Failure to produce an acceptable NOC may result in the candidate not being permitted to attend the interview or continue in the selection process.

How to Apply Online for SIDBI Recruitment 2026

Candidates can submit their applications exclusively through the official SIDBI website between 21 November and 11 December 2026.

  1. Visit the SIDBI website at www.sidbi.in.
  2. Open the Careers & Recruitment section and locate the Grade A and Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 advertisement.
  3. Select the official Apply Online option.
  4. Click "Click here for New Registration" and enter the required name, contact details and email ID.
  5. Save the provisional registration number and password generated by the system.
  6. Complete the personal, educational, experience and other relevant details in the application form.
  7. Upload the required photograph, signature, thumb impression and handwritten declaration according to the instructions.
  8. Use the Preview option to verify the entered information.
  9. After checking all details, select "Complete Registration".
  10. Open the Payment tab and pay the prescribed fee or intimation charges using the available online payment methods.
  11. Submit the application and save the generated e-receipt.
  12. Download or print the completed application form for future reference.

Important: Candidates can apply for only one post. SIDBI states that where multiple applications are submitted, only the latest valid completed application will be retained, and charges paid for other registrations will be forfeited.

Changes will not be permitted after completing registration. Applicants should therefore verify their details before final submission.

Agentic AI

Cloud FinOps

LLMOps / MLOps

AI Orchestration

  • Lead QA strategy, risk-based test planning, acceptance criteria, traceability and release-readiness.
  • Drive testing for ML, generative AI, LLM and agentic AI, including accuracy, groundedness, safety, bias, latency and permissions.
  • Build reusable automation, evaluation datasets, regression suites and CI/CD-integrated testing; govern defects and root-cause analysis.
  • Evaluate models, platforms and vendor solutions; coordinate production-readiness reviews and controlled releases.
  • KRAs: test coverage, defect leakage, quality-gate compliance, automation ratio, release readiness and timely defect closure.

Manager (Data Scientist)

  • Gen AI/Agentic AI: design, develop, deploy and operate secure, scalable AI, ML, GenAI, LLM and agentic-AI solutions for enterprise banking; build RAG pipelines, conversational systems, document-intelligence workflows, inference APIs, agents and knowledge bases.
  • OR MLOps/LLMOps: implement CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps practices; operate production pipelines on the Bank's on-premises AI platform for performance, GPU utilization and cost optimization.
  • OR AI Security & Governance: risk assessments, security reviews, threat modelling, adversarial testing and AI governance checks; guardrails, access controls and audit trails; compliance with RBI frameworks and Bank policies.
  • OR DevSecOps: integrate SAST, DAST, dependency and container security, infrastructure-as-code validation and automated compliance.
  • OR AI Quality Assurance – Testing: functional, integration, performance, security and AI-specific tests including bias, groundedness and explainability; maintain dashboards, defect logs and production-readiness evidence.

Deputy Manager (Data Scientist)

  • Front end: design, develop, test and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces for enterprise and AI-driven applications; convert UX/UI designs into reusable components; build interfaces for conversational AI, knowledge assistants, dashboards and agentic workflows; optimise rendering, load time and caching.
  • OR Integration (EIS/MuleSoft): develop end-to-end application components and integrate AI services, enterprise systems, APIs and data platforms; design integration between AI services and core banking systems.

SBI Recruitment 2026 Job Description

Activities / Functions

  • Provide consolidated visibility of observations arising from regulatory reviews, audits, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, red teaming and security incidents.
  • Prioritise risks based on business criticality, exploitability, external exposure, threat intelligence, regulatory implications and potential customer or operational impact.
  • Monitor remediation of critical and high-risk observations and facilitate resolution of cross-functional dependencies and bottlenecks.
  • Promote root-cause analysis and enterprise-wide corrective measures for systemic and recurring deficiencies.
  • Strengthen evidence-based closure through validation, retesting and residual-risk assessment.
  • Oversee improvements in vulnerability, patch, configuration, change, asset, application/API lifecycle and security advisory management.
  • Review the effectiveness and integration of DevSecOps, WAF, ITSAM, vulnerability management, DLP and SIEM platforms.
  • Provide oversight of emerging risks, including AI governance, SBOM/AIBOM maturity, ransomware readiness, backup assurance and digital/payment transaction risks.
  • Establish governance dashboards covering risk trends, ageing, remediation progress, recurring observations and residual risks.
  • Coordinate significant technology and cybersecurity matters with regulators, auditors, consultants and subject-matter experts.

KRAs

  • Provide strategic oversight of enterprise technology and cybersecurity risks, ensuring visibility, prioritisation and timely escalation.
  • Drive risk-based, systemic remediation of material audit, regulatory, vulnerability and security observations.
  • Oversee effectiveness of critical technology and cybersecurity controls and strengthen assurance mechanisms.
  • Strengthen cyber resilience, ransomware preparedness, recoverability and emerging technology risk governance.
  • Oversee regulatory commitments, security advisories, policy improvements and governance-based exception management.
  • Drive cross-functional accountability for resolution of systemic technology and cybersecurity risks.
  • Lead strategic governance reviews and provide senior management with consolidated risk posture for timely intervention.

Key interactions include application owners and GITC departments, ISD, Information Security, infrastructure, business and operational-risk functions, regulators, auditors, external consultants and technology partners. Measures of success include reduced ageing and recurrence of critical observations and timely systemic remediation. The notice says KRAs shall be assigned on joining, the job profile is illustrative, and additional roles may be assigned by the Bank.

How to Download RRB ALP CBT 1 Score Card 2026

What Information Is Available on the RRB ALP CBT 1 Score Card 2026?

Understanding what your scorecard contains will help you verify its accuracy and plan your next steps. The RRB ALP CBT 1 Score Card 2026 includes both personal and performance-related details.

When you receive the score card, verify the following information for accuracy:

  • Candidate Details: The candidate's full name and the RRB zone applied for.
  • Registration Number: The unique ID assigned during the application process.
  • Total Questions: Number of questions in the paper and how many were ignored, if any.
  • Raw Score: Marks calculated based on correct and incorrect responses.
  • Normalized Marks: The final score after adjusting for shift-wise difficulty level.
  • Shortlisted Status: A clear "Yes" or "No" indicating qualification for CBT 2. 

The normalized score is the most important figure it is this score that determines the candidate's rank in the merit list, not the raw marks.

How to Check RRB Group D Cut Off 2026?

  • Normalisation of marks across different examination shifts

RRB Group D Normalised Marks 2026

The RRB Group D CBT was conducted in multiple shifts. Normalisation is used to account for differences in examination difficulty across shifts.

The published cut-off scores are normalised marks. Candidates should compare their applicable normalised score with the cut-off for their railway region and category, rather than relying only on their estimated raw marks.

Candidates shortlisted through the RRB Group D CBT result will proceed to the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Those who qualify in PET will be considered for further recruitment stages as per the official selection procedure.

Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited (UPMRC) has released the recruitment notification UPMRC/HR/D/2/2026 for 1 Project Director post on a deputation basis. The notified pay scale for the post is Rs. 1,50,000- 3,00,000, with a normal tenure of deputation for a period of 3 years, which may be extendable. Eligible candidates holding a B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent from Government recognized University/Institute can apply. Applicants should submit their offline application by Speed post/By hand/Proper channel to Manager (HR) Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Administrative Building on or before 10 December 2026. The selection process consists of shortlisting of candidates for interview followed by an interview.

UPMRC Project Director at a Glance

Particulars Details
Organisation Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited (UPMRC)
Department or Unit Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited
Project Kanpur & Agra Metro Projects Phase 1B of the Lucknow Metro project
Post Project Director
Vacancies 1 (One) / Kanpur
Pay Rs. 1,50,000- 3,00,000 on Absorption basis, or Parent pay plus deputation allowance on Deputation basis
Contract Term Normal tenure of deputation for a period of 3 years, which may be extendable
Experience Required Minimum of five (5) years' experience in Planning / Construction, tendering and executing multi-disciplinary/ large infrastructure projects of Metro/ Railways
Job Location Kanpur (with liability to be posted at any of the project sites/ offices at any location of UPMRC projects)
How to Apply Offline (by Speed post/By hand/Proper channel)
Last Date 10 December 2026 (30 days from the date of notification of vacancy)
Selection Shortlisting of candidates for interview followed by interview

Who Can Apply

Candidates must fulfill the following educational qualification, experience, and age criteria to be eligible for the Project Director post:

  • Educational Qualification: B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent from Government recognized University/Institute.
  • Service Requirement (Option 1): The applicant should be working for atleast two years in SAG or an equivalent grade in the pay scale of Rs. 1,20,000-2,80,000 (IDA) or Rs. 1,44,200 - 2,18,200/Level-14 of 7th CPC Pay matrix (CDA) in Government organisations/ Government Metro companies, with proven track record of a minimum of twenty (20) years of service at Group A / Executive Level.
  • Service Requirement (Option 2): An applicant who is presently working in CDA/IDA pay scales in Government Organisations/ Government Metro Companies and has previously worked in the Private sector, his services in executive in reputed Private sector will also be considered for computing the requisite twenty (20) years of executive level service. In this regard, the applicant should submit necessary documents in support of executive level experience.
  • Eligible Work Experience: The candidate should have a minimum of five (5) years' experience in Planning/ Construction, tendering and executing multi-disciplinary/ large infrastructure projects of Metro/ Railways.
  • Age Limit: Max. 57 years as on the last date of vacancy notification (10/12/2026).

Desirable Work Experience

  • Experience in underground Metro constructions including tunnels.
  • Experience of all phases of project of internationally funded contracts i.e. planning, tender document preparation, bidding, execution, commissioning, post-commissioning etc.
  • Experience and knowledge of complying with project related requirements of international funding institutions.
  • Experience and knowledge of coordinating and interfacing with Railway related disciplines such as track installation, signaling, electrification and rolling stock etc.
  • Experience and knowledge of safety aspects relating to railway construction including clearance and certification from Commissioner of Railway Safety (CMRS).

Pay and Terms

The scale of pay is Rs. 1,50,000- 3,00,000 on Absorption basis. On Deputation basis, the selected candidate will receive Parent pay plus deputation allowance. The normal tenure of deputation is for a period of 3 years, which may be extendable. Applicants chosen on absorption basis will execute a Surety bond of Rs. 3,00,000/- to serve the Corporation for a minimum period of three years (exclusive of the period in which one remained in LWP or EOL) and provide three months prior notice before seeking resignation. Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of two years (including the period of training).

UPMRC Project Director Job Description

The incumbent of the post shall be responsible for the following duties and responsibilities:

  • Overall Project Management for all civil construction activities including safety and quality control, planning, scheduling, monitoring and controlling of preliminary and final designs, tendering, track works, contract administration and commissioning.
  • Project monitoring, interface management, quality assurance and safety, cost control of works for the project.
  • Land acquisition, rehabilitation of project affected persons/ businesses, utility and traffic diversions etc required for construction of the Metro Project.
  • Arranging necessary clearances and statutory approvals for implementation of project during construction and commissioning.

How to Apply for UPMRC Project Director

Candidates can apply for the position by following these steps:

  1. Download the prescribed proforma for submission of application from the official notification PDF.
  2. Fill out all required details in the application form accurately.
  3. Attach all required educational certificates, work experience certificates, APARs for the last 04 years, and D&AR/Vigilance clearance.
  4. For candidates applying through proper channel, ensure the application is forwarded through their parent organization with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance.
  5. Send the completed hard copy of the application along with supporting documents by post or by hand to the following address: Manager (HR) Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Administrative Building, Near Ambedkar Samajik Parivatan Sthal, Vipin Khand, Gomti nagar, Lucknow-226010.
  6. Applicants may send an advance copy of the application with all supporting documents via email to [email protected], but sending the hard copy of the application is mandatory.

Selection Process

Eligible candidates will be called for an interview at Lucknow. Selection is based on Interview basis. The Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview.

UPMRC Project Director Important Instructions

  • Cutoff date for age and eligibility criteria is reckoned as on the last date of notification of vacancy (10 December 2026).
  • The applicant must be physically and medically fit as per Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM).
  • Applications received after closing date and time or incomplete applications will not be entertained.
  • UPMRC will not be responsible for postal delays or wrong delivery.
  • All candidates called for interview shall not be paid any travelling allowance by UPMRC.

About DFCCIL

Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited is a Government of India (Ministry of Railways) Enterprise, described in the notice as an infrastructure initiative undertaken by Indian Railways to modernize freight transportation. It is creating high capacity, high speed, freight only rail corridors. This walk-in is for need-based re-employment of retired government employees of Indian Railways in the OP&BD department of DFCCIL.

Posts and Eligibility

The notice gives each post's eligibility by the pay level from which the officer retired, together with the place of posting of each post.

PostVacanciesWho Can ApplyPlace of Posting
JGM (OP&BD)2Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-13OCC/ADI – 1 post; OCC/PRYJ – 1 post
DGM (OP&BD)2Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-12Noida unit – 1 post; Mumbai unit – 1 post

Only the substantive/regular pay level/grade pay is considered. The MACP pay level/grade pay held at the time of retirement is not considered. The empanelment follows the eligibility criteria of HR Policy No. 28/2022 dated 22.07.2022 and 07/2026 dated 29.01.2026, based on the level from which the employee retired; in the attached policy table, Level-13 matches JGM (E6) and Level-12 matches DGM (E5).

The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-wise eligibility of each post.

Age Limit

Under the HR policy, re-employed employees are allowed to work up to the maximum age limit of 65 years. On the date of walk-in interview, the age of retired employees should not exceed 64 years, that is, on the date of advertisement one year of residual age to attain 65 years should remain available. Preference will be given to retired employees from Indian Railways with good health.

Pay and Allowances

PostPay
JGM (OP&BD), DGM (OP&BD)Fixed in terms of HR Policy; the attached Circular No. 28/2022 gives monthly remuneration @50% of last Basic Pay drawn plus applicable DA for re-employed retired employees

Conveyance allowance and mobile charges are governed by DFCCIL's policy, and no other allowance is admissible. In the attached circular, the re-employed post band "Manager (E-4) and above" gets conveyance charges of Rs. 4000/2000 per month (the lower figure if posted in cities other than Hyderabad, Delhi, Bangalore, Greater Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Surat, Nagpur, Pune, Jaipur, Lucknow and Kanpur urban agglomerations) and mobile charges of Rs. 500/- per month. For travel on duty, TA/DA/lodging is admissible as per the extant HR policy.

Tenure and Leave

  • Selected candidates are placed on a panel and re-employed/deployed based on requirement, initially for one year.
  • The period can be extended as per the requirements/performance of the retired employee, at the sole discretion of DFCCIL.
  • The re-employment can be terminated prematurely on one month's notice by either side.
  • Two days leave is granted for each completed month of contract, without a name such as CL or Earned Leave; accumulated leave cannot be carried forward to the next calendar year.
  • Deployment of selected employees will be made as per administrative/operational requirement.

Who Will Not Be Considered

  • Retired employees who earlier worked in DFCCIL in any capacity but were terminated from service for any reason, or were not granted extension of re-employment.
  • Persons borne on the current "Agreed/Secret" list while in service, involved in any current Vigilance/CBI case, or against whom disciplinary proceedings or prosecution are in process.
  • Persons imposed a major penalty, or two or more minor penalties, or against whom administrative action was taken three times or more, or who were imposed one minor penalty and two administrative actions as a result of Vigilance/CBI action while in service on Railways.
  • Persons against whom a minor penalty was imposed or administrative action taken as a result of Vigilance/CBI action during the last 5 years of service (for retired officers).

What to Bring

Candidates must bring the duly filled prescribed proforma attached to the notice – the Application Form (for Retired Employees), the Working Experience proforma, the Verification Form and the Declaration regarding D&AR/Vigilance Status – with the following:

  • Self-attested photocopies of PPO (as per 7th CPC) and Service Certificate
  • Last Pay Slip
  • Aadhar card
  • Cancelled cheque or copy of bank passbook
  • Two recent passport size photographs (one self-attested on the application form, one attested on the verification form)
  • Proof of identity and residence
  • Original Service Certificate/PPO and other documents for verification
  • Copy of complete bio-data, PPO no., PPF no., PAN no. and complete bank account details with IFSC code, as asked in the application form

Candidates who do not bring the documents on the date of interview will not be allowed for the interview.

What Happens on the Day

  1. Report at the DFCCIL Corporate Office, Noida, between 10.00 hrs and 12.00 hrs on 8 December 2026.
  2. DFCCIL officials check the applications; only those who meet the criteria of the advertisement and produce the Service Certificate/PPO (as per 7th CPC) and other relevant documents are allowed for interview.
  3. The walk-in interview is held to form a panel for the posts on re-employment basis. The attached policy says a committee of three members of GGM/GM/CGM level, constituted with the approval of the MD, selects re-employed officials, with marks out of 40 for domain knowledge and personality and qualifying marks of 60% out of 40.
  4. Selected candidates are issued an offer of appointment as per requirement.
  5. They must undergo a medical examination/health check-up and are re-employed only if found medically fit, in addition to fulfilling other criteria.

The attached policy also says that after orders for re-employment are issued, the verification form is sent for police verification; an adverse report leads to immediate termination and refund of remuneration paid.

Important Instructions

  • No TA/DA/journey expense is paid for appearing in the interview; candidates should arrange travel and stay in advance.
  • Wilful suppression of any material fact leads to summary rejection of candidature, and the candidate will not be interviewed.
  • Under the declaration, no payment is made until vigilance clearance is received, and services end without notice if anything adverse is found.
  • Furnishing false information in the form is a disqualification; if found during engagement, the contract is terminated and remuneration paid must be refunded.
  • The re-employment will not confer any right for regularization in DFCCIL.
  • Any dispute regarding this advertisement is under the jurisdiction of Court in Delhi only.

RRBs will also send SMS and email notifications to candidates using the contact details registered during the application process.

RRB NTPC Application Status 2026 Accepted or Rejected Meaning

The RRB NTPC Application Status 2026 is divided into three categories. Candidates should understand the meaning of each status before proceeding to the next recruitment stage.

Application Status Meaning Candidate Action
Provisionally Accepted The application has passed initial scrutiny, subject to further verification. Monitor official examination updates and retain supporting documents.
Provisionally Accepted with Conditions The application is accepted subject to specific conditions. Read and comply with the conditions shown in the candidate login.
Rejected The application has not been accepted after scrutiny. Check the rejection reason displayed in the portal.

Important: Provisional acceptance does not guarantee final eligibility, selection or appointment. Candidature may be cancelled if discrepancies or violations of recruitment conditions are identified during later verification.

RRB NTPC Application Status 2026 Rejected: What to Do?

Candidates whose applications have been rejected should log in to the official RRB application portal and review the reason displayed against their registration.

Application rejection may be associated with eligibility issues, inconsistent details, invalid documentation or non-compliance with recruitment instructions. Candidates should rely on the specific reason provided in their own application-status dashboard rather than assuming a generic cause.

How to Calculate Marks Using CONCOR Answer Key 2026?

Candidates can estimate their CBT marks by comparing their recorded responses with the provisional answer key.

Based on the reported marking scheme, the calculation is:

Estimated Marks = (Correct Answers × 1) - (Incorrect Answers × 0.25)

Response Type Marks
Correct Answer +1
Incorrect Answer -0.25
Unattempted Question 0

For example, if a candidate answers 75 questions correctly and 15 questions incorrectly, the estimated score will be 71.25 marks.

These calculations are indicative. The final evaluated score may change if any provisional answers are revised after objection review.

How to Calculate Marks Using UPSSSC Havaldar Answer Key 2026?

Candidates can use the provisional answer key to estimate their Main Written Examination marks by following the prescribed marking scheme.

  1. Count the number of correct answers.
  2. Count the number of incorrect answers.
  3. Award one mark for each correct response.
  4. Deduct 0.25 mark for every incorrect response.
  5. Calculate the estimated total marks.

Estimated Score = Number of Correct Answers - (Number of Incorrect Answers × 0.25)

For example, a candidate with 75 correct answers and 16 incorrect answers would obtain an estimated score of 71 marks.

This is a provisional calculation. Final scores depend on the answers accepted by UPSSSC and the applicable evaluation rules.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

Role Snapshot

Voltus runs demand response programs across North American wholesale markets and utilities. As the Senior Energy Markets Analyst for PJM, you will own our PJM utility programs end to end. You will run one established utility program and help launch a second, newer one. You will also support Product and Partnerships in sizing and designing the next set of PJM utility programs, where much of our future revenue and margin sits.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will manage your own work, with your manager setting priorities and reviewing results rather than directing day-to-day tasks. For each program you own, you will be the go-to expert inside Voltus and the main contact for the utility.

What you will do

Run our PJM utility programs end to end: registrations, nominations, dispatch, performance calculations and settlements.

Help launch a new program and identify the next ones with Product and Partnerships.

Advise Product and Partnerships on program design, opportunity sizing and utility proposals. You will not draft formal regulatory filings.

Explain program rules in plain language to Sales, customers and Dispatch Ops, and write to utilities and PJM on registration and settlement issues.

Support PJM - ELRP (Load Management) registrations starting in 2028.

Guide and review the work of co-op and junior analysts. This role has no direct reports.

What success looks like

Within 60 days, you know the established program well enough to run it without the team's involvement.

Registrations, nominations, tests, events and quarterly settlements are on time and accurate, and your manager reviews rather than does.

New program registrations are submitted on time with no missed deadlines, and enrolled MW is at or near target.

Baseline and performance methodology is agreed with Engineering and Product before the first dispatch.

A written playbook for the new program exists that someone else could pick up.

Product, Partnerships, Dispatch Ops and utility contacts come to you directly.

Your analysis has informed a program design discussion with Product and Partnerships.

What you bring

Required

3 to 5 years of hands-on energy markets experience in demand response or a closely related area (registrations, performance calculations, settlements), in any ISO or utility program.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: trackers, baseline-versus-metered-load calculations, and settlement reconciliations that others can audit.

Basic SQL: read-only queries with joins, aggregations and filters to pull site, interval and dispatch data.

Basic Python, with familiarity with Pandas, to process interval data across many sites and automate repetitive registration and settlement prep.

Clear written communication, including plain-language explanations of program rules and professional correspondence with utilities and ISOs.

Ownership: you make judgment calls on ambiguous program rules, know when to escalate, and build process where none exists.

Availability during core Eastern hours and during test and event windows. PJM, the utilities and all program deadlines run on Eastern time.

Preferred

PJM experience, in this order of relevance: DR programs (ELRP, utility DR programs in PJM states); settlements and performance calculations; capacity market basics (PLCs, nominations, delivery year calendar); wholesale market operations.

Strong DR candidates from ERCOT, NYISO or MISO are encouraged to apply.Â

Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally.

Build the shared foundation other iOS engineers build on: design-system components, shared libraries, networking and persistence layers, and the dev harness (build times, CI, test infrastructure, release tooling).

Build and roll out the AI-collaborative development tooling iOS engineers use every day, and set the standards for how we use it on the client.

Improve client production health infrastructure: crash and performance monitoring, alerting, release quality, and the security posture of the app.

Partner with server engineering on API design and client-server state sync, and with the product client teams so new features land on solid patterns.

Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code review, mentorship, and clear written specs.

You use AI coding tools in your daily work, help the team adopt them, and look for opportunities to improve the engineering harness.

Deep experience with SwiftUI alongside UIKit and with Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, strict concurrency), including migrating a mature codebase to them. CoreData a plus!

Experience with Xcode build performance, Swift Package Manager or Bazel/Tuist, and CI/CD for iOS at scale.

Has built developer tooling, agents, or evals that other engineers adopted: code review agents, lint and architecture rules, test generation, or LLM-powered dev harnesses.

Occasional comfort or interest in shipping production backend code (Node.js/TypeScript) alongside the client, and designing the APIs mobile clients depend on.

Role Snapshot

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

Traits for Success

  • Passionate about health, wellness, longevity, or human performance.
  • Writes clearly and cares about the member on the other end of every message.
  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment
  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment
  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.
